0.label: Genesis 1:1
0.text: In [the] beginning God created the heavens and the earth.

1.label: Genesis 1:2
1.text: Now the earth proved to be formless and waste and there was darkness upon the surface of [the] watery deep; and God’s active force was moving to and fro over the surface of the waters.

2.label: Genesis 1:3
2.text: And God proceeded to say: “Let light come to be.” Then there came to be light.

3.label: Genesis 1:4
3.text: After that God saw that the light was good, and God brought about a division between the light and the darkness.

4.label: Genesis 1:5
4.text: And God began calling the light Day, but the darkness he called Night. And there came to be evening and there came to be morning, a first day.

5.label: Genesis 1:6
5.text: And God went on to say: “Let an expanse come to be in between the waters and let a dividing occur between the waters and the waters.”

6.label: Genesis 1:7
6.text: Then God proceeded to make the expanse and to make a division between the waters that should be beneath the expanse and the waters that should be above the expanse. And it came to be so.

7.label: Genesis 1:8
7.text: And God began to call the expanse Heaven. And there came to be evening and there came to be morning, a second day.

8.label: Genesis 1:9
8.text: And God went on to say: “Let the waters under the heavens be brought together into one place and let the dry land appear.” And it came to be so.

9.label: Genesis 1:10
9.text: And God began calling the dry land Earth, but the bringing together of the waters he called Seas. Further, God saw that [it was] good.

10.label: Genesis 1:11
10.text: And God went on to say: “Let the earth cause grass to shoot forth, vegetation bearing seed, fruit trees yielding fruit according to their kinds, the seed of which is in it, upon the earth.” And it came to be so.

11.label: Genesis 1:12
11.text: And the earth began to put forth grass, vegetation bearing seed according to its kind and trees yielding fruit, the seed of which is in it according to its kind. Then God saw that [it was] good.

12.label: Genesis 1:13
12.text: And there came to be evening and there came to be morning, a third day.

13.label: Genesis 1:14
13.text: And God went on to say: “Let luminaries come to be in the expanse of the heavens to make a division between the day and the night; and they must serve as signs and for seasons and for days and years.

14.label: Genesis 1:15
14.text: And they must serve as luminaries in the expanse of the heavens to shine upon the earth.” And it came to be so.

15.label: Genesis 1:16
15.text: And God proceeded to make the two great luminaries, the greater luminary for dominating the day and the lesser luminary for dominating the night, and also the stars.

16.label: Genesis 1:17
16.text: Thus God put them in the expanse of the heavens to shine upon the earth,

17.label: Genesis 1:18
17.text: and to dominate by day and by night and to make a division between the light and the darkness. Then God saw that [it was] good.

18.label: Genesis 1:19
18.text: And there came to be evening and there came to be morning, a fourth day.

19.label: Genesis 1:20
19.text: And God went on to say: “Let the waters swarm forth a swarm of living souls and let flying creatures fly over the earth upon the face of the expanse of the heavens.”

20.label: Genesis 1:21
20.text: And God proceeded to create the great sea monsters and every living soul that moves about, which the waters swarmed forth according to their kinds, and every winged flying creature according to its kind. And God got to see that [it was] good.

21.label: Genesis 1:22
21.text: With that God blessed them, saying: “Be fruitful and become many and fill the waters in the sea basins, and let the flying creatures become many in the earth.”

22.label: Genesis 1:23
22.text: And there came to be evening and there came to be morning, a fifth day.

23.label: Genesis 1:24
23.text: And God went on to say: “Let the earth put forth living souls according to their kinds, domestic animal and moving animal and wild beast of the earth according to its kind.” And it came to be so.

24.label: Genesis 1:25
24.text: And God proceeded to make the wild beast of the earth according to its kind and the domestic animal according to its kind and every moving animal of the ground according to its kind. And God got to see that [it was] good.

25.label: Genesis 1:26
25.text: And God went on to say: “Let us make man in our image, according to our likeness, and let them have in subjection the fish of the sea and the flying creatures of the heavens and the domestic animals and all the earth and every moving animal that is moving upon the earth.”

26.label: Genesis 1:27
26.text: And God proceeded to create the man in his image, in God’s image he created him; male and female he created them.

27.label: Genesis 1:28
27.text: Further, God blessed them and God said to them: “Be fruitful and become many and fill the earth and subdue it, and have in subjection the fish of the sea and the flying creatures of the heavens and every living creature that is moving upon the earth.”

28.label: Genesis 1:29
28.text: And God went on to say: “Here I have given to YOU all vegetation bearing seed which is on the surface of the whole earth and every tree on which there is the fruit of a tree bearing seed. To YOU let it serve as food.

29.label: Genesis 1:30
29.text: And to every wild beast of the earth and to every flying creature of the heavens and to everything moving upon the earth in which there is life as a soul I have given all green vegetation for food.” And it came to be so.

30.label: Genesis 1:31
30.text: After that God saw everything he had made and, look! [it was] very good. And there came to be evening and there came to be morning, a sixth day.

31.label: Genesis 2:1
31.text: Thus the heavens and the earth and all their army came to their completion.

32.label: Genesis 2:2
32.text: And by the seventh day God came to the completion of his work that he had made, and he proceeded to rest on the seventh day from all his work that he had made.

33.label: Genesis 2:3
33.text: And God proceeded to bless the seventh day and make it sacred, because on it he has been resting from all his work that God has created for the purpose of making.

34.label: Genesis 2:4
34.text: This is a history of the heavens and the earth in the time of their being created, in the day that Jehovah God made earth and heaven.

35.label: Genesis 2:5
35.text: Now there was as yet no bush of the field found in the earth and no vegetation of the field was as yet sprouting, because Jehovah God had not made it rain upon the earth and there was no man to cultivate the ground.

36.label: Genesis 2:6
36.text: But a mist would go up from the earth and it watered the entire surface of the ground.

37.label: Genesis 2:7
37.text: And Jehovah God proceeded to form the man out of dust from the ground and to blow into his nostrils the breath of life, and the man came to be a living soul.

38.label: Genesis 2:8
38.text: Further, Jehovah God planted a garden in Eʹden, toward the east, and there he put the man whom he had formed.

39.label: Genesis 2:9
39.text: Thus Jehovah God made to grow out of the ground every tree desirable to one’s sight and good for food and also the tree of life in the middle of the garden and the tree of the knowledge of good and bad.

40.label: Genesis 2:10
40.text: Now there was a river issuing out of Eʹden to water the garden, and from there it began to be parted and it became, as it were, four heads.

41.label: Genesis 2:11
41.text: The first one’s name is Piʹshon; it is the one encircling the entire land of Havʹi·lah, where there is gold.

42.label: Genesis 2:12
42.text: And the gold of that land is good. There also are the bdellium gum and the onyx stone.

43.label: Genesis 2:13
43.text: And the name of the second river is Giʹhon; it is the one encircling the entire land of Cush.

44.label: Genesis 2:14
44.text: And the name of the third river is Hidʹde·kel; it is the one going to the east of As·syrʹi·a. And the fourth river is the Eu·phraʹtes.

45.label: Genesis 2:15
45.text: And Jehovah God proceeded to take the man and settle him in the garden of Eʹden to cultivate it and to take care of it.

46.label: Genesis 2:16
46.text: And Jehovah God also laid this command upon the man: “From every tree of the garden you may eat to satisfaction.

47.label: Genesis 2:17
47.text: But as for the tree of the knowledge of good and bad you must not eat from it, for in the day you eat from it you will positively die.”

48.label: Genesis 2:18
48.text: And Jehovah God went on to say: “It is not good for the man to continue by himself. I am going to make a helper for him, as a complement of him.”

49.label: Genesis 2:19
49.text: Now Jehovah God was forming from the ground every wild beast of the field and every flying creature of the heavens, and he began bringing them to the man to see what he would call each one; and whatever the man would call it, each living soul, that was its name.

50.label: Genesis 2:20
50.text: So the man was calling the names of all the domestic animals and of the flying creatures of the heavens and of every wild beast of the field, but for man there was found no helper as a complement of him.

51.label: Genesis 2:21
51.text: Hence Jehovah God had a deep sleep fall upon the man and, while he was sleeping, he took one of his ribs and then closed up the flesh over its place.

52.label: Genesis 2:22
52.text: And Jehovah God proceeded to build the rib that he had taken from the man into a woman and to bring her to the man.

53.label: Genesis 2:23
53.text: Then the man said:“This is at last bone of my bonesAnd flesh of my flesh. This one will be called Woman, Because from man this one was taken.”

54.label: Genesis 2:24
54.text: That is why a man will leave his father and his mother and he must stick to his wife and they must become one flesh.

55.label: Genesis 2:25
55.text: And both of them continued to be naked, the man and his wife, and yet they did not become ashamed.

56.label: Genesis 3:1
56.text: Now the serpent proved to be the most cautious of all the wild beasts of the field that Jehovah God had made. So it began to say to the woman: “Is it really so that God said YOU must not eat from every tree of the garden?”

57.label: Genesis 3:2
57.text: At this the woman said to the serpent: “Of the fruit of the trees of the garden we may eat.

58.label: Genesis 3:3
58.text: But as for [eating] of the fruit of the tree that is in the middle of the garden, God has said, ‘YOU must not eat from it, no, YOU must not touch it that YOU do not die.’”

59.label: Genesis 3:4
59.text: At this the serpent said to the woman: “YOU positively will not die.

60.label: Genesis 3:5
60.text: For God knows that in the very day of YOUR eating from it YOUR eyes are bound to be opened and YOU are bound to be like God, KNOWING good and bad.”

61.label: Genesis 3:6
61.text: Consequently the woman saw that the tree was good for food and that it was something to be longed for to the eyes, yes, the tree was desirable to look upon. So she began taking of its fruit and eating it. Afterward she gave some also to her husband when with her and he began eating it.

62.label: Genesis 3:7
62.text: Then the eyes of both of them became opened and they began to realize that they were naked. Hence they sewed fig leaves together and made loin coverings for themselves.

63.label: Genesis 3:8
63.text: Later they heard the voice of Jehovah God walking in the garden about the breezy part of the day, and the man and his wife went into hiding from the face of Jehovah God in between the trees of the garden.

64.label: Genesis 3:9
64.text: And Jehovah God kept calling to the man and saying to him: “Where are you?”

65.label: Genesis 3:10
65.text: Finally he said: “Your voice I heard in the garden, but I was afraid because I was naked and so I hid myself.”

66.label: Genesis 3:11
66.text: At that he said: “Who told you that you were naked? From the tree from which I commanded you not to eat have you eaten?”

67.label: Genesis 3:12
67.text: And the man went on to say: “The woman whom you gave to be with me, she gave me [fruit] from the tree and so I ate.”

68.label: Genesis 3:13
68.text: With that Jehovah God said to the woman: “What is this you have done?” To this the woman replied: “The serpent—it deceived me and so I ate.”

69.label: Genesis 3:14
69.text: And Jehovah God proceeded to say to the serpent: “Because you have done this thing, you are the cursed one out of all the domestic animals and out of all the wild beasts of the field. Upon your belly you will go and dust is what you will eat all the days of your life.

70.label: Genesis 3:15
70.text: And I shall put enmity between you and the woman and between your seed and her seed. He will bruise you in the head and you will bruise him in the heel.”

71.label: Genesis 3:16
71.text: To the woman he said: “I shall greatly increase the pain of your pregnancy; in birth pangs you will bring forth children, and your craving will be for your husband, and he will dominate you.”

72.label: Genesis 3:17
72.text: And to Adam he said: “Because you listened to your wife’s voice and took to eating from the tree concerning which I gave you this command, ‘You must not eat from it,’ cursed is the ground on your account. In pain you will eat its produce all the days of your life.

73.label: Genesis 3:18
73.text: And thorns and thistles it will grow for you, and you must eat the vegetation of the field.

74.label: Genesis 3:19
74.text: In the sweat of your face you will eat bread until you return to the ground, for out of it you were taken. For dust you are and to dust you will return.”

75.label: Genesis 3:20
75.text: After this Adam called his wife’s name Eve, because she had to become the mother of everyone living.

76.label: Genesis 3:21
76.text: And Jehovah God proceeded to make long garments of skin for Adam and for his wife and to clothe them.

77.label: Genesis 3:22
77.text: And Jehovah God went on to say: “Here the man has become like one of us in knowing good and bad, and now in order that he may not put his hand out and actually take [fruit] also from the tree of life and eat and live to time indefinite,—”

78.label: Genesis 3:23
78.text: With that Jehovah God put him out of the garden of Eʹden to cultivate the ground from which he had been taken.

79.label: Genesis 3:24
79.text: And so he drove the man out and posted at the east of the garden of Eʹden the cherubs and the flaming blade of a sword that was turning itself continually to guard the way to the tree of life.

80.label: Genesis 4:1
80.text: Now Adam had intercourse with Eve his wife and she became pregnant. In time she gave birth to Cain and said: “I have produced a man with the aid of Jehovah.”

81.label: Genesis 4:2
81.text: Later she again gave birth, to his brother Abel. And Abel came to be a herder of sheep, but Cain became a cultivator of the ground.

82.label: Genesis 4:3
82.text: And it came about at the expiration of some time that Cain proceeded to bring some fruits of the ground as an offering to Jehovah.

83.label: Genesis 4:4
83.text: But as for Abel, he too brought some firstlings of his flock, even their fatty pieces. Now while Jehovah was looking with favor upon Abel and his offering,

84.label: Genesis 4:5
84.text: he did not look with any favor upon Cain and upon his offering. And Cain grew hot with great anger, and his countenance began to fall.

85.label: Genesis 4:6
85.text: At this Jehovah said to Cain: “Why are you hot with anger and why has your countenance fallen?

86.label: Genesis 4:7
86.text: If you turn to doing good, will there not be an exaltation? But if you do not turn to doing good, there is sin crouching at the entrance, and for you is its craving; and will you, for your part, get the mastery over it?”

87.label: Genesis 4:8
87.text: After that Cain said to Abel his brother: [“Let us go over into the field.”] So it came about that while they were in the field Cain proceeded to assault Abel his brother and kill him.

88.label: Genesis 4:9
88.text: Later on Jehovah said to Cain: “Where is Abel your brother?” and he said: “I do not know. Am I my brother’s guardian?”

89.label: Genesis 4:10
89.text: At this he said: “What have you done? Listen! Your brother’s blood is crying out to me from the ground.

90.label: Genesis 4:11
90.text: And now you are cursed in banishment from the ground, which has opened its mouth to receive your brother’s blood at your hand.

91.label: Genesis 4:12
91.text: When you cultivate the ground, it will not give you back its power. A wanderer and a fugitive you will become in the earth.”

92.label: Genesis 4:13
92.text: At this Cain said to Jehovah: “My punishment for error is too great to carry.

93.label: Genesis 4:14
93.text: Here you are actually driving me this day from off the surface of the ground, and from your face I shall be concealed; and I must become a wanderer and fugitive on the earth, and it is certain that anyone finding me will kill me.”

94.label: Genesis 4:15
94.text: At this Jehovah said to him: “For that reason anyone killing Cain must suffer vengeance seven times.” And so Jehovah set up a sign for Cain in order that no one finding him should strike him.

95.label: Genesis 4:16
95.text: With that Cain went away from the face of Jehovah and took up residence in the land of Fugitiveness to the east of Eʹden.

96.label: Genesis 4:17
96.text: Afterward Cain had intercourse with his wife and she became pregnant and gave birth to Eʹnoch. Then he engaged in building a city and called the city’s name by the name of his son Eʹnoch.

97.label: Genesis 4:18
97.text: Later there was born to Eʹnoch Iʹrad. And Iʹrad became father to Me·huʹja·el, and Me·huʹja·el became father to Me·thuʹsha·el, and Me·thuʹsha·el became father to Laʹmech.

98.label: Genesis 4:19
98.text: And Laʹmech proceeded to take two wives for himself. The name of the first was Aʹdah and the name of the second was Zilʹlah.

99.label: Genesis 4:20
99.text: In time Aʹdah gave birth to Jaʹbal. He proved to be the founder of those who dwell in tents and have livestock.

100.label: Genesis 4:21
100.text: And the name of his brother was Juʹbal. He proved to be the founder of all those who handle the harp and the pipe.

101.label: Genesis 4:22
101.text: As for Zilʹlah, she too gave birth to Tuʹbal-cain, the forger of every sort of tool of copper and iron. And the sister of Tuʹbal-cain was Naʹa·mah.

102.label: Genesis 4:23
102.text: Consequently Laʹmech composed these words for his wives Aʹdah and Zilʹlah: “Hear my voice, you wives of Laʹmech;Give ear to my saying: A man I have killed for wounding me, Yes, a young man for giving me a blow.

103.label: Genesis 4:24
103.text: If seven times Cain is to be avenged, Then Laʹmech seventy times and seven.”

104.label: Genesis 4:25
104.text: And Adam proceeded to have intercourse again with his wife and so she gave birth to a son and called his name Seth, because, as she said: “God has appointed another seed in place of Abel, because Cain killed him.”

105.label: Genesis 4:26
105.text: And to Seth also there was born a son and he proceeded to call his name Eʹnosh. At that time a start was made of calling on the name of Jehovah.

106.label: Genesis 5:1
106.text: This is the book of Adam’s history. In the day of God’s creating Adam he made him in the likeness of God.

107.label: Genesis 5:2
107.text: Male and female he created them. After that he blessed them and called their name Man in the day of their being created.

108.label: Genesis 5:3
108.text: And Adam lived on for a hundred and thirty years. Then he became father to a son in his likeness, in his image, and called his name Seth.

109.label: Genesis 5:4
109.text: And the days of Adam after his fathering Seth came to be eight hundred years. Meanwhile he became father to sons and daughters.

110.label: Genesis 5:5
110.text: So all the days of Adam that he lived amounted to nine hundred and thirty years and he died.

111.label: Genesis 5:6
111.text: And Seth lived on for a hundred and five years. Then he became father to Eʹnosh.

112.label: Genesis 5:7
112.text: And after his fathering Eʹnosh Seth continued to live eight hundred and seven years. Meanwhile he became father to sons and daughters.

113.label: Genesis 5:8
113.text: So all the days of Seth amounted to nine hundred and twelve years and he died.

114.label: Genesis 5:9
114.text: And Eʹnosh lived on for ninety years. Then he became father to Keʹnan.

115.label: Genesis 5:10
115.text: And after his fathering Keʹnan Eʹnosh continued to live eight hundred and fifteen years. Meanwhile he became father to sons and daughters.

116.label: Genesis 5:11
116.text: So all the days of Eʹnosh amounted to nine hundred and five years and he died.

117.label: Genesis 5:12
117.text: And Keʹnan lived on for seventy years. Then he became father to Ma·halʹa·lel.

118.label: Genesis 5:13
118.text: And after his fathering Ma·halʹa·lel Keʹnan continued to live eight hundred and forty years. Meanwhile he became father to sons and daughters.

119.label: Genesis 5:14
119.text: So all the days of Keʹnan amounted to nine hundred and ten years and he died.

120.label: Genesis 5:15
120.text: And Ma·halʹa·lel lived on for sixty-five years. Then he became father to Jaʹred.

121.label: Genesis 5:16
121.text: And after his fathering Jaʹred Ma·halʹa·lel continued to live eight hundred and thirty years. Meanwhile he became father to sons and daughters.

122.label: Genesis 5:17
122.text: So all the days of Ma·halʹa·lel amounted to eight hundred and ninety-five years and he died.

123.label: Genesis 5:18
123.text: And Jaʹred lived on for a hundred and sixty-two years. Then he became father to Eʹnoch.

124.label: Genesis 5:19
124.text: And after his fathering Eʹnoch Jaʹred continued to live eight hundred years. Meanwhile he became father to sons and daughters.

125.label: Genesis 5:20
125.text: So all the days of Jaʹred amounted to nine hundred and sixty-two years and he died.

126.label: Genesis 5:21
126.text: And Eʹnoch lived on for sixty-five years. Then he became father to Me·thuʹse·lah.

127.label: Genesis 5:22
127.text: And after his fathering Me·thuʹse·lah Eʹnoch went on walking with the [true] God three hundred years. Meanwhile he became father to sons and daughters.

128.label: Genesis 5:23
128.text: So all the days of Eʹnoch amounted to three hundred and sixty-five years.

129.label: Genesis 5:24
129.text: And Eʹnoch kept walking with the [true] God. Then he was no more, for God took him.

130.label: Genesis 5:25
130.text: And Me·thuʹse·lah lived on for a hundred and eighty-seven years. Then he became father to Laʹmech.

131.label: Genesis 5:26
131.text: And after his fathering Laʹmech Me·thuʹse·lah continued to live seven hundred and eighty-two years. Meanwhile he became father to sons and daughters.

132.label: Genesis 5:27
132.text: So all the days of Me·thuʹse·lah amounted to nine hundred and sixty-nine years and he died.

133.label: Genesis 5:28
133.text: And Laʹmech lived on for a hundred and eighty-two years. Then he became father to a son.

134.label: Genesis 5:29
134.text: And he proceeded to call his name Noah, saying: “This one will bring us comfort from our work and from the pain of our hands resulting from the ground which Jehovah has cursed.”

135.label: Genesis 5:30
135.text: And after his fathering Noah Laʹmech continued to live five hundred and ninety-five years. Meanwhile he became father to sons and daughters.

136.label: Genesis 5:31
136.text: So all the days of Laʹmech amounted to seven hundred and seventy-seven years and he died.

137.label: Genesis 5:32
137.text: And Noah got to be five hundred years old. After that Noah became father to Shem, Ham and Jaʹpheth.

138.label: Genesis 6:1
138.text: Now it came about that when men started to grow in numbers on the surface of the ground and daughters were born to them,

139.label: Genesis 6:2
139.text: then the sons of the [true] God began to notice the daughters of men, that they were good-looking; and they went taking wives for themselves, namely, all whom they chose.

140.label: Genesis 6:3
140.text: After that Jehovah said: “My spirit shall not act toward man indefinitely in that he is also flesh. Accordingly his days shall amount to a hundred and twenty years.”

141.label: Genesis 6:4
141.text: The Nephʹi·lim proved to be in the earth in those days, and also after that, when the sons of the [true] God continued to have relations with the daughters of men and they bore sons to them, they were the mighty ones who were of old, the men of fame.

142.label: Genesis 6:5
142.text: Consequently Jehovah saw that the badness of man was abundant in the earth and every inclination of the thoughts of his heart was only bad all the time.

143.label: Genesis 6:6
143.text: And Jehovah felt regrets that he had made men in the earth, and he felt hurt at his heart.

144.label: Genesis 6:7
144.text: So Jehovah said: “I am going to wipe men whom I have created off the surface of the ground, from man to domestic animal, to moving animal and to flying creature of the heavens, because I do regret that I have made them.”

145.label: Genesis 6:8
145.text: But Noah found favor in the eyes of Jehovah.

146.label: Genesis 6:9
146.text: This is the history of Noah. Noah was a righteous man. He proved himself faultless among his contemporaries. Noah walked with the [true] God.

147.label: Genesis 6:10
147.text: In time Noah became father to three sons, Shem, Ham and Jaʹpheth.

148.label: Genesis 6:11
148.text: And the earth came to be ruined in the sight of the [true] God and the earth became filled with violence.

149.label: Genesis 6:12
149.text: So God saw the earth and, look! it was ruined, because all flesh had ruined its way on the earth.

150.label: Genesis 6:13
150.text: After that God said to Noah: “The end of all flesh has come before me, because the earth is full of violence as a result of them; and here I am bringing them to ruin together with the earth.

151.label: Genesis 6:14
151.text: Make for yourself an ark out of wood of a resinous tree. You will make compartments in the ark, and you must cover it inside and outside with tar.

152.label: Genesis 6:15
152.text: And this is how you will make it: three hundred cubits the length of the ark, fifty cubits its width, and thirty cubits its height.

153.label: Genesis 6:16
153.text: You will make a tsoʹhar [roof; or, window] for the ark, and you will complete it to the extent of a cubit upward, and the entrance of the ark you will put in its side; you will make it with a lower [story], a second [story] and a third [story].

154.label: Genesis 6:17
154.text: “And as for me, here I am bringing the deluge of waters upon the earth to bring to ruin all flesh in which the force of life is active from under the heavens. Everything that is in the earth will expire.

155.label: Genesis 6:18
155.text: And I do establish my covenant with you; and you must go into the ark, you and your sons and your wife and your sons’ wives with you.

156.label: Genesis 6:19
156.text: And of every living creature of every sort of flesh, two of each, you will bring into the ark to preserve them alive with you. Male and female they will be.

157.label: Genesis 6:20
157.text: Of the flying creatures according to their kinds and of the domestic animals according to their kinds, of all moving animals of the ground according to their kinds, two of each will go in there to you to preserve them alive.

158.label: Genesis 6:21
158.text: And as for you, take for yourself every sort of food that is eaten; and you must gather it to yourself, and it must serve as food for you and for them.”

159.label: Genesis 6:22
159.text: And Noah proceeded to do according to all that God had commanded him. He did just so.

160.label: Genesis 7:1
160.text: After that Jehovah said to Noah: “Go, you and all your household, into the ark, because you are the one I have seen to be righteous before me among this generation.

161.label: Genesis 7:2
161.text: Of every clean beast you must take to yourself by sevens, the sire and its mate; and of every beast that is not clean just two, the sire and its mate;

162.label: Genesis 7:3
162.text: also of the flying creatures of the heavens by sevens, male and female, to preserve offspring alive on the surface of the entire earth.

163.label: Genesis 7:4
163.text: For in just seven days more I am making it rain upon the earth forty days and forty nights; and I will wipe every existing thing that I have made off the surface of the ground.”

164.label: Genesis 7:5
164.text: And Noah proceeded to do according to all that Jehovah had commanded him.

165.label: Genesis 7:6
165.text: And Noah was six hundred years old when the deluge of waters occurred on the earth.

166.label: Genesis 7:7
166.text: So Noah went in, and his sons and his wife and his sons’ wives with him, into the ark ahead of the waters of the deluge.

167.label: Genesis 7:8
167.text: Of every clean beast and of every beast that is not clean and of the flying creatures and everything that moves on the ground,

168.label: Genesis 7:9
168.text: they went in by twos to Noah inside the ark, male and female, just as God had commanded Noah.

169.label: Genesis 7:10
169.text: And seven days later it turned out that the waters of the deluge came upon the earth.

170.label: Genesis 7:11
170.text: In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, in the second month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on this day all the springs of the vast watery deep were broken open and the floodgates of the heavens were opened.

171.label: Genesis 7:12
171.text: And the downpour upon the earth went on for forty days and forty nights.

172.label: Genesis 7:13
172.text: On this very day Noah went in, and Shem and Ham and Jaʹpheth, Noah’s sons, and the wife of Noah and the three wives of his sons with him, into the ark;

173.label: Genesis 7:14
173.text: they and every wild beast according to its kind, and every domestic animal according to its kind, and every moving animal that moves on the earth according to its kind, and every flying creature according to its kind, every bird, every winged creature.

174.label: Genesis 7:15
174.text: And they kept going to Noah inside the ark, two by two, of every sort of flesh in which the force of life was active.

175.label: Genesis 7:16
175.text: And those going in, male and female of every sort of flesh, went in, just as God had commanded him. After that Jehovah shut the door behind him.

176.label: Genesis 7:17
176.text: And the deluge went on for forty days upon the earth, and the waters kept increasing and began carrying the ark and it was floating high above the earth.

177.label: Genesis 7:18
177.text: And the waters became overwhelming and kept increasing greatly upon the earth, but the ark kept going on the surface of the waters.

178.label: Genesis 7:19
178.text: And the waters overwhelmed the earth so greatly that all the tall mountains that were under the whole heavens came to be covered.

179.label: Genesis 7:20
179.text: Up to fifteen cubits the waters overwhelmed them and the mountains became covered.

180.label: Genesis 7:21
180.text: So all flesh that was moving upon the earth expired, among the flying creatures and among the domestic animals and among the wild beasts and among all the swarms that were swarming upon the earth, and all mankind.

181.label: Genesis 7:22
181.text: Everything in which the breath of the force of life was active in its nostrils, namely, all that were on the dry ground, died.

182.label: Genesis 7:23
182.text: Thus he wiped out every existing thing that was on the surface of the ground, from man to beast, to moving animal and to flying creature of the heavens, and they were wiped off the earth; and only Noah and those who were with him in the ark kept on surviving.

183.label: Genesis 7:24
183.text: And the waters continued overwhelming the earth a hundred and fifty days.

184.label: Genesis 8:1
184.text: After that God remembered Noah and every wild beast and every domestic animal that was with him in the ark, and God caused a wind to pass over the earth, and the waters began to subside.

185.label: Genesis 8:2
185.text: And the springs of the watery deep and the floodgates of the heavens became stopped up, and so the downpour from the heavens was restrained.

186.label: Genesis 8:3
186.text: And the waters began receding from off the earth, progressively receding; and at the end of a hundred and fifty days the waters were lacking.

187.label: Genesis 8:4
187.text: And in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, the ark came to rest on the mountains of Arʹa·rat.

188.label: Genesis 8:5
188.text: And the waters kept on progressively lessening until the tenth month. In the tenth month, on the first of the month, the tops of the mountains appeared.

189.label: Genesis 8:6
189.text: So it occurred that at the end of forty days Noah proceeded to open the window of the ark that he had made.

190.label: Genesis 8:7
190.text: After that he sent out a raven, and it continued flying outdoors, going and returning, until the waters dried off the earth.

191.label: Genesis 8:8
191.text: Later he sent out from him a dove to see whether the waters had abated from the surface of the ground.

192.label: Genesis 8:9
192.text: And the dove did not find any resting-place for the sole of its foot, and so it returned to him into the ark because the waters were yet upon the surface of the whole earth. At that he put his hand out and took it and brought it to himself inside the ark.

193.label: Genesis 8:10
193.text: And he went on waiting still another seven days, and once again he sent out the dove from the ark.

194.label: Genesis 8:11
194.text: Later on the dove came to him about the time of evening and, look! there was an olive leaf freshly plucked in its bill, and so Noah got to know that the waters had abated from the earth.

195.label: Genesis 8:12
195.text: And he went on waiting still another seven days. Then he sent out the dove, but it did not come back again to him anymore.

196.label: Genesis 8:13
196.text: Now in the six hundred and first year, in the first month, on the first day of the month, it came about that the waters had drained from off the earth; and Noah proceeded to remove the covering of the ark and to look, and here the surface of the ground had drained dry.

197.label: Genesis 8:14
197.text: And in the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, the earth had dried off.

198.label: Genesis 8:15
198.text: God now spoke to Noah, saying:

199.label: Genesis 8:16
199.text: “Go out of the ark, you and your wife and your sons and your sons’ wives with you.

200.label: Genesis 8:17
200.text: Every living creature that is with you of every sort of flesh, among the flying creatures and among the beasts and among all the moving animals that move upon the earth, bring out with you, as they must swarm in the earth and be fruitful and become many upon the earth.”

201.label: Genesis 8:18
201.text: At that Noah went out, and also his sons and his wife and his sons’ wives with him.

202.label: Genesis 8:19
202.text: Every living creature, every moving animal and every flying creature, everything that moves on the earth, according to their families they went out of the ark.

203.label: Genesis 8:20
203.text: And Noah began to build an altar to Jehovah and to take some of all the clean beasts and of all the clean flying creatures and to offer burnt offerings upon the altar.

204.label: Genesis 8:21
204.text: And Jehovah began to smell a restful odor, and so Jehovah said in his heart: “Never again shall I call down evil upon the ground on man’s account, because the inclination of the heart of man is bad from his youth up; and never again shall I deal every living thing a blow just as I have done.

205.label: Genesis 8:22
205.text: For all the days the earth continues, seed sowing and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night, will never cease.”

206.label: Genesis 9:1
206.text: And God went on to bless Noah and his sons and to say to them: “Be fruitful and become many and fill the earth.

207.label: Genesis 9:2
207.text: And a fear of YOU and a terror of YOU will continue upon every living creature of the earth and upon every flying creature of the heavens, upon everything that goes moving on the ground, and upon all the fishes of the sea. Into YOUR hand they are now given.

208.label: Genesis 9:3
208.text: Every moving animal that is alive may serve as food for YOU. As in the case of green vegetation, I do give it all to YOU.

209.label: Genesis 9:4
209.text: Only flesh with its soul —its blood —YOU must not eat.

210.label: Genesis 9:5
210.text: And, besides that, YOUR blood of YOUR souls shall I ask back. From the hand of every living creature shall I ask it back; and from the hand of man, from the hand of each one who is his brother, shall I ask back the soul of man.

211.label: Genesis 9:6
211.text: Anyone shedding man’s blood, by man will his own blood be shed, for in God’s image he made man.

212.label: Genesis 9:7
212.text: And as for YOU men, be fruitful and become many, make the earth swarm with YOU and become many in it.”

213.label: Genesis 9:8
213.text: And God went on to say to Noah and to his sons with him:

214.label: Genesis 9:9
214.text: “And as for me, here I am establishing my covenant with YOU men and with YOUR offspring after YOU,

215.label: Genesis 9:10
215.text: and with every living soul that is with YOU, among fowls, among beasts and among all living creatures of the earth with YOU, from all those going out of the ark to every living creature of the earth.

216.label: Genesis 9:11
216.text: Yes, I do establish my covenant with YOU: No more will all flesh be cut off by waters of a deluge, and no more will there occur a deluge to bring the earth to ruin.”

217.label: Genesis 9:12
217.text: And God added: “This is the sign of the covenant that I am giving between me and YOU and every living soul that is with YOU, for the generations to time indefinite.

218.label: Genesis 9:13
218.text: My rainbow I do give in the cloud, and it must serve as a sign of the covenant between me and the earth.

219.label: Genesis 9:14
219.text: And it shall occur that when I bring a cloud over the earth, then the rainbow will certainly appear in the cloud.

220.label: Genesis 9:15
220.text: And I shall certainly remember my covenant which is between me and YOU and every living soul among all flesh; and no more will the waters become a deluge to bring all flesh to ruin.

221.label: Genesis 9:16
221.text: And the rainbow must occur in the cloud, and I shall certainly see it to remember the covenant to time indefinite between God and every living soul among all flesh that is upon the earth.”

222.label: Genesis 9:17
222.text: And God repeated to Noah: “This is the sign of the covenant that I do establish between me and all flesh that is upon the earth.”

223.label: Genesis 9:18
223.text: And Noah’s sons who came out of the ark were Shem and Ham and Jaʹpheth. Later Ham was the father of Caʹnaan.

224.label: Genesis 9:19
224.text: These three were Noah’s sons, and from these was all the earth’s population spread abroad.

225.label: Genesis 9:20
225.text: Now Noah started off as a farmer and proceeded to plant a vineyard.

226.label: Genesis 9:21
226.text: And he began drinking of the wine and became intoxicated, and so he uncovered himself in the midst of his tent.

227.label: Genesis 9:22
227.text: Later Ham the father of Caʹnaan saw his father’s nakedness and went telling it to his two brothers outside.

228.label: Genesis 9:23
228.text: At that Shem and Jaʹpheth took a mantle and put it upon both their shoulders and walked in backwards. Thus they covered their father’s nakedness, while their faces were turned away, and they did not see their father’s nakedness.

229.label: Genesis 9:24
229.text: Finally Noah awoke from his wine and got to know what his youngest son had done to him.

230.label: Genesis 9:25
230.text: At this he said: “Cursed be Caʹnaan. Let him become the lowest slave to his brothers.”

231.label: Genesis 9:26
231.text: And he added:“Blessed be Jehovah, Shem’s God,And let Caʹnaan become a slave to him.

232.label: Genesis 9:27
232.text: Let God grant ample space to Jaʹpheth,And let him reside in the tents of Shem. Let Caʹnaan become a slave to him also.”

233.label: Genesis 9:28
233.text: And Noah continued to live three hundred and fifty years after the deluge.

234.label: Genesis 9:29
234.text: So all the days of Noah amounted to nine hundred and fifty years and he died.

235.label: Genesis 10:1
235.text: And this is the history of Noah’s sons, Shem, Ham and Jaʹpheth. Now sons began to be born to them after the deluge.

236.label: Genesis 10:2
236.text: The sons of Jaʹpheth were Goʹmer and Maʹgog and Maʹda·i and Jaʹvan and Tuʹbal and Meʹshech and Tiʹras.

237.label: Genesis 10:3
237.text: And the sons of Goʹmer were Ashʹke·naz and Riʹphath and To·garʹmah.

238.label: Genesis 10:4
238.text: And the sons of Jaʹvan were E·liʹshah and Tarʹshish, Kitʹtim and Doʹda·nim.

239.label: Genesis 10:5
239.text: From these the population of the isles of the nations was spread about in their lands, each according to its tongue, according to their families, by their nations.

240.label: Genesis 10:6
240.text: And the sons of Ham were Cush and Mizʹra·im and Put and Caʹnaan.

241.label: Genesis 10:7
241.text: And the sons of Cush were Seʹba and Havʹi·lah and Sabʹtah and Raʹa·mah and Sabʹte·ca. And the sons of Raʹa·mah were Sheʹba and Deʹdan.

242.label: Genesis 10:8
242.text: And Cush became father to Nimʹrod. He made the start in becoming a mighty one in the earth.

243.label: Genesis 10:9
243.text: He displayed himself a mighty hunter in opposition to Jehovah. That is why there is a saying: “Just like Nimʹrod a mighty hunter in opposition to Jehovah.”

244.label: Genesis 10:10
244.text: And the beginning of his kingdom came to be Baʹbel and Eʹrech and Acʹcad and Calʹneh, in the land of Shiʹnar.

245.label: Genesis 10:11
245.text: Out of that land he went forth into As·syrʹi·a and set himself to building Ninʹe·veh and Re·hoʹboth-Ir and Caʹlah

246.label: Genesis 10:12
246.text: and Reʹsen between Ninʹe·veh and Caʹlah: this is the great city.

247.label: Genesis 10:13
247.text: And Mizʹra·im became father to Luʹdim and Anʹa·mim and Le·haʹbim and Naph·tuʹhim

248.label: Genesis 10:14
248.text: and Path·ruʹsim and Cas·luʹhim (from among whom the Phi·lisʹtines went forth) and Caphʹto·rim.

249.label: Genesis 10:15
249.text: And Caʹnaan became father to Siʹdon his firstborn and Heth

250.label: Genesis 10:16
250.text: and the Jebʹu·site and the Amʹor·ite and the Girʹga·shite

251.label: Genesis 10:17
251.text: and the Hiʹvite and the Arkʹite and the Siʹnite

252.label: Genesis 10:18
252.text: and the Arʹvad·ite and the Zemʹa·rite and the Haʹmath·ite; and afterward the families of the Caʹnaan·ite were scattered.

253.label: Genesis 10:19
253.text: So the boundary of the Caʹnaan·ite came to be from Siʹdon as far as Geʹrar, near Gaʹza, as far as Sodʹom and Go·morʹrah and Adʹmah and Ze·boiʹim, near Laʹsha.

254.label: Genesis 10:20
254.text: These were the sons of Ham according to their families, according to their tongues, in their lands, by their nations.

255.label: Genesis 10:21
255.text: And to Shem, the forefather of all the sons of Eʹber, the brother of Jaʹpheth the oldest, there was also progeny born.

256.label: Genesis 10:22
256.text: The sons of Shem were Eʹlam and Asʹshur and Ar·pachʹshad and Lud and Aʹram.

257.label: Genesis 10:23
257.text: And the sons of Aʹram were Uz and Hul and Geʹther and Mash.

258.label: Genesis 10:24
258.text: And Ar·pachʹshad became father to Sheʹlah, and Sheʹlah became father to Eʹber.

259.label: Genesis 10:25
259.text: And to Eʹber there were two sons born. The name of the one was Peʹleg, because in his days the earth was divided; and the name of his brother was Jokʹtan.

260.label: Genesis 10:26
260.text: And Jokʹtan became father to Al·moʹdad and Sheʹleph and Ha·zar·maʹveth and Jeʹrah

261.label: Genesis 10:27
261.text: and Ha·doʹram and Uʹzal and Dikʹlah

262.label: Genesis 10:28
262.text: and Oʹbal and A·bimʹa·el and Sheʹba

263.label: Genesis 10:29
263.text: and Oʹphir and Havʹi·lah and Joʹbab; all these were the sons of Jokʹtan.

264.label: Genesis 10:30
264.text: And their place of dwelling came to extend from Meʹsha as far as Seʹphar, the mountainous region of the East.

265.label: Genesis 10:31
265.text: These were the sons of Shem according to their families, according to their tongues, in their lands, according to their nations.

266.label: Genesis 10:32
266.text: These were the families of the sons of Noah according to their family descents, by their nations, and from these the nations were spread about in the earth after the deluge.

267.label: Genesis 11:1
267.text: Now all the earth continued to be of one language and of one set of words.

268.label: Genesis 11:2
268.text: And it came about that in their journeying eastward they eventually discovered a valley plain in the land of Shiʹnar, and they took up dwelling there.

269.label: Genesis 11:3
269.text: And they began to say, each one to the other: “Come on! Let us make bricks and bake them with a burning process.” So brick served as stone for them, but bitumen served as mortar for them.

270.label: Genesis 11:4
270.text: They now said: “Come on! Let us build ourselves a city and also a tower with its top in the heavens, and let us make a celebrated name for ourselves, for fear we may be scattered over all the surface of the earth.”

271.label: Genesis 11:5
271.text: And Jehovah proceeded to go down to see the city and the tower that the sons of men had built.

272.label: Genesis 11:6
272.text: After that Jehovah said: “Look! They are one people and there is one language for them all, and this is what they start to do. Why, now there is nothing that they may have in mind to do that will be unattainable for them.

273.label: Genesis 11:7
273.text: Come now! Let us go down and there confuse their language that they may not listen to one another’s language.”

274.label: Genesis 11:8
274.text: Accordingly Jehovah scattered them from there over all the surface of the earth, and they gradually left off building the city.

275.label: Genesis 11:9
275.text: That is why its name was called Baʹbel, because there Jehovah had confused the language of all the earth, and Jehovah had scattered them from there over all the surface of the earth.

276.label: Genesis 11:10
276.text: This is the history of Shem. Shem was a hundred years old when he became father to Ar·pachʹshad two years after the deluge.

277.label: Genesis 11:11
277.text: And after his fathering Ar·pachʹshad Shem continued to live five hundred years. Meanwhile he became father to sons and daughters.

278.label: Genesis 11:12
278.text: And Ar·pachʹshad lived thirty-five years. Then he became father to Sheʹlah.

279.label: Genesis 11:13
279.text: And after his fathering Sheʹlah Ar·pachʹshad continued to live four hundred and three years. Meanwhile he became father to sons and daughters.

280.label: Genesis 11:14
280.text: And Sheʹlah lived thirty years. Then he became father to Eʹber.

281.label: Genesis 11:15
281.text: And after his fathering Eʹber Sheʹlah continued to live four hundred and three years. Meanwhile he became father to sons and daughters.

282.label: Genesis 11:16
282.text: And Eʹber lived on for thirty-four years. Then he became father to Peʹleg.

283.label: Genesis 11:17
283.text: And after his fathering Peʹleg Eʹber continued to live four hundred and thirty years. Meanwhile he became father to sons and daughters.

284.label: Genesis 11:18
284.text: And Peʹleg lived on for thirty years. Then he became father to Reʹu.

285.label: Genesis 11:19
285.text: And after his fathering Reʹu Peʹleg continued to live two hundred and nine years. Meanwhile he became father to sons and daughters.

286.label: Genesis 11:20
286.text: And Reʹu lived on for thirty-two years. Then he became father to Seʹrug.

287.label: Genesis 11:21
287.text: And after his fathering Seʹrug Reʹu continued to live two hundred and seven years. Meanwhile he became father to sons and daughters.

288.label: Genesis 11:22
288.text: And Seʹrug lived on for thirty years. Then he became father to Naʹhor.

289.label: Genesis 11:23
289.text: And after his fathering Naʹhor Seʹrug continued to live two hundred years. Meanwhile he became father to sons and daughters.

290.label: Genesis 11:24
290.text: And Naʹhor lived on for twenty-nine years. Then he became father to Teʹrah.

291.label: Genesis 11:25
291.text: And after his fathering Teʹrah Naʹhor continued to live a hundred and nineteen years. Meanwhile he became father to sons and daughters.

292.label: Genesis 11:26
292.text: And Teʹrah lived on for seventy years, after which he became father to Aʹbram, Naʹhor and Haʹran.

293.label: Genesis 11:27
293.text: And this is the history of Teʹrah. Teʹrah became father to Aʹbram, Naʹhor and Haʹran; and Haʹran became father to Lot.

294.label: Genesis 11:28
294.text: Later Haʹran died while in company with Teʹrah his father in the land of his birth, in Ur of the Chal·deʹans.

295.label: Genesis 11:29
295.text: And Aʹbram and Naʹhor proceeded to take wives for themselves. The name of Aʹbram’s wife was Sarʹai, while the name of Naʹhor’s wife was Milʹcah, the daughter of Haʹran, the father of Milʹcah and father of Isʹcah.

296.label: Genesis 11:30
296.text: But Sarʹai continued to be barren; she had no child.

297.label: Genesis 11:31
297.text: After that Teʹrah took Aʹbram his son and Lot, the son of Haʹran, his grandson, and Sarʹai his daughter-in-law, the wife of Aʹbram his son, and they went with him out of Ur of the Chal·deʹans to go to the land of Caʹnaan. In time they came to Haʹran and took up dwelling there.

298.label: Genesis 11:32
298.text: And the days of Teʹrah came to be two hundred and five years. Then Teʹrah died in Haʹran.

299.label: Genesis 12:1
299.text: And Jehovah proceeded to say to Aʹbram: “Go your way out of your country and from your relatives and from the house of your father to the country that I shall show you;

300.label: Genesis 12:2
300.text: and I shall make a great nation out of you and I shall bless you and I will make your name great; and prove yourself a blessing.

301.label: Genesis 12:3
301.text: And I will bless those who bless you, and him that calls down evil upon you I shall curse, and all the families of the ground will certainly bless themselves by means of you.”

302.label: Genesis 12:4
302.text: At that Aʹbram went just as Jehovah had spoken to him, and Lot went with him. And Aʹbram was seventy-five years old when he went out from Haʹran.

303.label: Genesis 12:5
303.text: So Aʹbram took Sarʹai his wife and Lot the son of his brother and all the goods that they had accumulated and the souls whom they had acquired in Haʹran, and they got on their way out to go to the land of Caʹnaan. Finally they came to the land of Caʹnaan.

304.label: Genesis 12:6
304.text: And Aʹbram went on through the land as far as the site of Sheʹchem, near the big trees of Moʹreh; and at that time the Caʹnaan·ite was in the land.

305.label: Genesis 12:7
305.text: Jehovah now appeared to Aʹbram and said: “To your seed I am going to give this land.” After that he built an altar there to Jehovah, who had appeared to him.

306.label: Genesis 12:8
306.text: Later he moved from there to the mountainous region to the east of Bethʹel and pitched his tent with Bethʹel on the west and Aʹi on the east. Then he built an altar there to Jehovah and began to call on the name of Jehovah.

307.label: Genesis 12:9
307.text: Afterward Aʹbram broke camp, going then from encampment to encampment toward the Negʹeb.

308.label: Genesis 12:10
308.text: Now a famine arose in the land and Aʹbram made his way down toward Egypt to reside there as an alien, because the famine was severe in the land.

309.label: Genesis 12:11
309.text: And it came about that as soon as he got near to entering Egypt, then he said to Sarʹai his wife: “Please, now! I well know you are a woman beautiful in appearance.

310.label: Genesis 12:12
310.text: So it is bound to happen that the Egyptians will see you and will say, ‘This is his wife.’ And they will certainly kill me, but you they will preserve alive.

311.label: Genesis 12:13
311.text: Please say you are my sister, in order that it may go well with me on your account, and my soul will be certain to live due to you.”

312.label: Genesis 12:14
312.text: So it happened that, as soon as Aʹbram entered Egypt, the Egyptians got to see the woman, that she was very beautiful.

313.label: Genesis 12:15
313.text: And the princes of Pharʹaoh also got to see her and they began praising her to Pharʹaoh, so that the woman was taken to the house of Pharʹaoh.

314.label: Genesis 12:16
314.text: And he treated Aʹbram well on her account, and he came to have sheep and cattle and asses and menservants and maidservants and she-asses and camels.

315.label: Genesis 12:17
315.text: Then Jehovah touched Pharʹaoh and his household with great plagues because of Sarʹai, Aʹbram’s wife.

316.label: Genesis 12:18
316.text: With that Pharʹaoh called Aʹbram and said: “What is this you have done to me? Why did you not tell me that she was your wife?

317.label: Genesis 12:19
317.text: Why did you say, ‘She is my sister,’ so that I was about to take her as my wife? And now here is your wife. Take her and go!”

318.label: Genesis 12:20
318.text: And Pharʹaoh issued commands to men concerning him, and they went escorting him and his wife and all that he had.

319.label: Genesis 13:1
319.text: Following that Aʹbram went up out of Egypt, he and his wife and all that he had, and Lot with him, to the Negʹeb.

320.label: Genesis 13:2
320.text: And Aʹbram was heavily stocked with herds and silver and gold.

321.label: Genesis 13:3
321.text: And he made his way from encampment to encampment out of the Negʹeb and to Bethʹel, to the place where his tent had been at first between Bethʹel and Aʹi,

322.label: Genesis 13:4
322.text: to the place of the altar that he had made there originally; and Aʹbram proceeded to call there on the name of Jehovah.

323.label: Genesis 13:5
323.text: Now Lot, who was going along with Aʹbram, also owned sheep and cattle and tents.

324.label: Genesis 13:6
324.text: So the land did not allow for them to dwell all together, because their goods had become many and they were not able to dwell all together.

325.label: Genesis 13:7
325.text: And a quarrel arose between the herders of Aʹbram’s livestock and the herders of Lot’s livestock; and at that time the Caʹnaan·ite and the Perʹiz·zite were dwelling in the land.

326.label: Genesis 13:8
326.text: Hence Aʹbram said to Lot: “Please, do not let any quarreling continue between me and you and between my herdsmen and your herdsmen, for we men are brothers.

327.label: Genesis 13:9
327.text: Is not the whole land available to you? Please, separate from me. If you go to the left, then I will go to the right; but if you go to the right, then I will go to the left.”

328.label: Genesis 13:10
328.text: So Lot raised his eyes and saw the whole District of the Jordan, that all of it was a well-watered region before Jehovah brought Sodʹom and Go·morʹrah to ruin, like the garden of Jehovah, like the land of Egypt as far as Zoʹar.

329.label: Genesis 13:11
329.text: Then Lot chose for himself the whole District of the Jordan, and Lot moved his camp to the east. So they separated the one from the other.

330.label: Genesis 13:12
330.text: Aʹbram dwelt in the land of Caʹnaan, but Lot dwelt among the cities of the District. Finally he pitched tent near Sodʹom.

331.label: Genesis 13:13
331.text: And the men of Sodʹom were bad and were gross sinners against Jehovah.

332.label: Genesis 13:14
332.text: And Jehovah said to Aʹbram after Lot had separated from him: “Raise your eyes, please, and look from the place where you are, northward and southward and eastward and westward,

333.label: Genesis 13:15
333.text: because all the land at which you are looking, to you and to your seed I am going to give it until time indefinite.

334.label: Genesis 13:16
334.text: And I will constitute your seed like the dust particles of the earth, so that, if a man could be able to count the dust particles of the earth, then your seed could be numbered.

335.label: Genesis 13:17
335.text: Get up, go about in the land through its length and through its breadth, because to you I am going to give it.”

336.label: Genesis 13:18
336.text: So Aʹbram continued to live in tents. Later on he came and dwelt among the big trees of Mamʹre, which are in Heʹbron; and there he proceeded to build an altar to Jehovah.

337.label: Genesis 14:1
337.text: Now it came about in the days of Amʹra·phel king of Shiʹnar, Arʹi·och king of El·laʹsar, Ched·or·la·oʹmer king of Eʹlam, and Tiʹdal king of Goiʹim,

338.label: Genesis 14:2
338.text: that these made war with Beʹra king of Sodʹom, and with Birʹsha king of Go·morʹrah, Shiʹnab king of Adʹmah, and Shem·eʹber king of Ze·boiʹim, and the king of Beʹla (that is to say, Zoʹar).

339.label: Genesis 14:3
339.text: All these marched as allies to the Low Plain of Sidʹdim, that is, the Salt Sea.

340.label: Genesis 14:4
340.text: Twelve years they had served Ched·or·la·oʹmer, but the thirteenth year they rebelled.

341.label: Genesis 14:5
341.text: And in the fourteenth year Ched·or·la·oʹmer came, and also the kings who were with him, and they inflicted defeats on the Rephʹa·im in Ashʹte·roth-kar·naʹim, and the Zuʹzim in Ham, and the Eʹmim in Shaʹveh-kir·i·a·thaʹim,

342.label: Genesis 14:6
342.text: and the Horʹites in their mountain of Seʹir, down to El-paʹran, which is at the wilderness.

343.label: Genesis 14:7
343.text: Then they turned about and came to En-mishʹpat, that is, Kaʹdesh, and defeated the whole field of the A·malʹek·ites and also the Amʹor·ites who were dwelling in Hazʹa·zon-taʹmar.

344.label: Genesis 14:8
344.text: At this point the king of Sodʹom went on the march, and also the king of Go·morʹrah and the king of Adʹmah and the king of Ze·boiʹim and the king of Beʹla (that is to say, Zoʹar), and they drew up in battle order against them in the Low Plain of Sidʹdim,

345.label: Genesis 14:9
345.text: against Ched·or·la·oʹmer king of Eʹlam and Tiʹdal king of Goiʹim and Amʹra·phel king of Shiʹnar and Arʹi·och king of El·laʹsar; four kings against the five.

346.label: Genesis 14:10
346.text: Now the Low Plain of Sidʹdim was pits upon pits of bitumen; and the kings of Sodʹom and Go·morʹrah took to flight and went falling into them, and those who remained fled to the mountainous region.

347.label: Genesis 14:11
347.text: Then the victors took all the goods of Sodʹom and Go·morʹrah and all their food and went on their way.

348.label: Genesis 14:12
348.text: They also took Lot the son of Aʹbram’s brother and his goods and continued on their way. He was then dwelling in Sodʹom.

349.label: Genesis 14:13
349.text: After that a man who had escaped came and told Aʹbram the Hebrew. He was then tabernacling among the big trees of Mamʹre the Amʹor·ite, the brother of Eshʹcol and brother of Aʹner; and they were confederates of Aʹbram.

350.label: Genesis 14:14
350.text: Thus Aʹbram got to hear that his brother had been taken captive. With that he mustered his trained men, three hundred and eighteen slaves born in his household, and went in pursuit up to Dan.

351.label: Genesis 14:15
351.text: And by night he resorted to dividing his forces, he and his slaves, against them, and thus he defeated them and kept in pursuit of them up to Hoʹbah, which is north of Damascus.

352.label: Genesis 14:16
352.text: And he proceeded to recover all the goods, and he recovered also Lot his brother and his goods and also the women and the people.

353.label: Genesis 14:17
353.text: Then the king of Sodʹom went out to meet him after he returned from defeating Ched·or·la·oʹmer and the kings that were with him, to the Low Plain of Shaʹveh, that is, the king’s Low Plain.

354.label: Genesis 14:18
354.text: And Mel·chizʹe·dek king of Saʹlem brought out bread and wine, and he was priest of the Most High God.

355.label: Genesis 14:19
355.text: Then he blessed him and said: “Blessed be Aʹbram of the Most High God, Producer of heaven and earth;

356.label: Genesis 14:20
356.text: And blessed be the Most High God, Who has delivered your oppressors into your hand!” At that Aʹbram gave him a tenth of everything.

357.label: Genesis 14:21
357.text: After that the king of Sodʹom said to Aʹbram: “Give me the souls, but take the goods for yourself.”

358.label: Genesis 14:22
358.text: At this Aʹbram said to the king of Sodʹom: “I do lift up my hand [in an oath] to Jehovah the Most High God, Producer of heaven and earth,

359.label: Genesis 14:23
359.text: that, from a thread to a sandal lace, no, I shall take nothing from anything that is yours, in order that you may not say, ‘It was I who made Aʹbram rich.’

360.label: Genesis 14:24
360.text: Nothing for me! Only what the young men have already eaten, and the share of the men who went with me, Aʹner, Eshʹcol and Mamʹre —let them take their share.”

361.label: Genesis 15:1
361.text: After these things the word of Jehovah came to Aʹbram in a vision, saying: “Do not fear, Aʹbram. I am a shield for you. Your reward will be very great.”

362.label: Genesis 15:2
362.text: At this Aʹbram said: “Sovereign Lord Jehovah, what will you give me, seeing that I am going childless and the one who will possess my house is a man of Damascus, E·li·eʹzer?”

363.label: Genesis 15:3
363.text: And Aʹbram added: “Look! You have given me no seed, and, look! a son of my household is succeeding me as heir.”

364.label: Genesis 15:4
364.text: But, look! the word of Jehovah to him was in these words: “This man will not succeed you as heir, but one who will come out of your own inward parts will succeed you as heir.”

365.label: Genesis 15:5
365.text: He now brought him outside and said: “Look up, please, to the heavens and count the stars, if you are possibly able to count them.” And he went on to say to him: “So your seed will become.”

366.label: Genesis 15:6
366.text: And he put faith in Jehovah; and he proceeded to count it to him as righteousness.

367.label: Genesis 15:7
367.text: Then he added to him: “I am Jehovah, who brought you out of Ur of the Chal·deʹans to give you this land to take it in possession.”

368.label: Genesis 15:8
368.text: To this he said: “Sovereign Lord Jehovah, by what shall I know that I shall take it in possession?”

369.label: Genesis 15:9
369.text: In turn he said to him: “Take for me a three-year-old heifer and a three-year-old she-goat and a three-year-old ram and a turtledove and a young pigeon.”

370.label: Genesis 15:10
370.text: So he took all these to himself and cut them in two and put each part of them so as to match the other, but the birds he did not cut in pieces.

371.label: Genesis 15:11
371.text: And the birds of prey began to descend upon the carcasses, but Aʹbram kept driving them away.

372.label: Genesis 15:12
372.text: After a while the sun was about to set, and a deep sleep fell upon Aʹbram, and, look! a frightfully great darkness was falling upon him.

373.label: Genesis 15:13
373.text: And he began to say to Aʹbram: “You may know for sure that your seed will become an alien resident in a land not theirs, and they will have to serve them, and these will certainly afflict them for four hundred years.

374.label: Genesis 15:14
374.text: But the nation that they will serve I am judging, and after that they will go out with many goods.

375.label: Genesis 15:15
375.text: As for you, you will go to your forefathers in peace; you will be buried at a good old age.

376.label: Genesis 15:16
376.text: But in the fourth generation they will return here, because the error of the Amʹor·ites has not yet come to completion.”

377.label: Genesis 15:17
377.text: The sun was now setting and a dense darkness came and, look! a smoking furnace and a fiery torch that passed in between these pieces.

378.label: Genesis 15:18
378.text: On that day Jehovah concluded with Aʹbram a covenant, saying: “To your seed I will give this land, from the river of Egypt to the great river, the river Eu·phraʹtes:

379.label: Genesis 15:19
379.text: the Kenʹites and the Kenʹiz·zites and the Kadʹmon·ites

380.label: Genesis 15:20
380.text: and the Hitʹtites and the Perʹiz·zites and the Rephʹa·im

381.label: Genesis 15:21
381.text: and the Amʹor·ites and the Caʹnaan·ites and the Girʹga·shites and the Jebʹu·sites.”

382.label: Genesis 16:1
382.text: Now Sarʹai, Aʹbram’s wife, had borne him no children; but she had an Egyptian maidservant and her name was Haʹgar.

383.label: Genesis 16:2
383.text: Hence Sarʹai said to Aʹbram: “Please now! Jehovah has shut me off from bearing children. Please, have relations with my maidservant. Perhaps I may get children from her.” So Aʹbram listened to the voice of Sarʹai.

384.label: Genesis 16:3
384.text: Then Sarʹai, Aʹbram’s wife, took Haʹgar, her Egyptian maidservant, at the end of ten years of Aʹbram’s dwelling in the land of Caʹnaan, and gave her to Aʹbram her husband as his wife.

385.label: Genesis 16:4
385.text: Accordingly he had relations with Haʹgar, and she became pregnant. When she became aware that she was pregnant, then her mistress began to be despised in her eyes.

386.label: Genesis 16:5
386.text: At this Sarʹai said to Aʹbram: “The violence done me be upon you. I myself gave my maidservant over to your bosom, and she became aware that she was pregnant, and I began to be despised in her eyes. May Jehovah judge between me and you.”

387.label: Genesis 16:6
387.text: So Aʹbram said to Sarʹai: “Look! Your maidservant is at your disposal. Do to her what is good in your eyes.” Then Sarʹai began to humiliate her so that she ran away from her.

388.label: Genesis 16:7
388.text: Later Jehovah’s angel found her at a fountain of waters in the wilderness, at the fountain on the way to Shur.

389.label: Genesis 16:8
389.text: And he began to say: “Haʹgar, maidservant of Sarʹai, just where have you come from and where are you going?” To this she said: “Why, from Sarʹai my mistress I am running away.”

390.label: Genesis 16:9
390.text: And Jehovah’s angel went on to say to her: “Return to your mistress and humble yourself under her hand.”

391.label: Genesis 16:10
391.text: Then Jehovah’s angel said to her: “I shall greatly multiply your seed, so that it will not be numbered for multitude.”

392.label: Genesis 16:11
392.text: Further Jehovah’s angel added to her: “Here you are pregnant, and you shall give birth to a son and must call his name Ishʹma·el; for Jehovah has heard your affliction.

393.label: Genesis 16:12
393.text: As for him, he will become a zebra of a man. His hand will be against everyone, and the hand of everyone will be against him; and before the face of all his brothers he will tabernacle.”

394.label: Genesis 16:13
394.text: Then she began to call the name of Jehovah, who was speaking to her: “You are a God of sight,” for she said: “Have I here actually looked upon him who sees me?”

395.label: Genesis 16:14
395.text: That is why the well was called Beʹer-laʹhai-roi. Here it is between Kaʹdesh and Beʹred.

396.label: Genesis 16:15
396.text: Later on Haʹgar bore to Aʹbram a son and Aʹbram called the name of his son whom Haʹgar bore Ishʹma·el.

397.label: Genesis 16:16
397.text: And Aʹbram was eighty-six years old at Haʹgar’s bearing Ishʹma·el to Aʹbram.

398.label: Genesis 17:1
398.text: When Aʹbram got to be ninety-nine years old, then Jehovah appeared to Aʹbram and said to him: “I am God Almighty. Walk before me and prove yourself faultless.

399.label: Genesis 17:2
399.text: And I will give my covenant between me and you, that I may multiply you very, very much.”

400.label: Genesis 17:3
400.text: At this Aʹbram fell upon his face, and God continued to speak with him, saying:

401.label: Genesis 17:4
401.text: “As for me, look! my covenant is with you, and you will certainly become a father of a crowd of nations.

402.label: Genesis 17:5
402.text: And your name will not be called Aʹbram anymore, and your name must become Abraham, because a father of a crowd of nations I will make you.

403.label: Genesis 17:6
403.text: And I will make you very, very fruitful and will make you become nations, and kings will come out of you.

404.label: Genesis 17:7
404.text: “And I will carry out my covenant between me and you and your seed after you according to their generations for a covenant to time indefinite, to prove myself God to you and to your seed after you.

405.label: Genesis 17:8
405.text: And I will give to you and to your seed after you the land of your alien residences, even the entire land of Caʹnaan, for a possession to time indefinite; and I will prove myself God to them.”

406.label: Genesis 17:9
406.text: And God said further to Abraham: “As for you, you are to keep my covenant, you and your seed after you according to their generations.

407.label: Genesis 17:10
407.text: This is my covenant that YOU men will keep, between me and YOU men, even your seed after you: Every male of YOURS must get circumcised.

408.label: Genesis 17:11
408.text: And YOU must get circumcised in the flesh of YOUR foreskins, and it must serve as a sign of the covenant between me and YOU.

409.label: Genesis 17:12
409.text: And every male of YOURS eight days old must be circumcised, according to your generations, anyone born in the house and anyone purchased with money from any foreigner who is not from your seed.

410.label: Genesis 17:13
410.text: Every man born in your house and every man purchased with money of yours must without fail get circumcised; and my covenant in the flesh of YOU men must serve as a covenant to time indefinite.

411.label: Genesis 17:14
411.text: And an uncircumcised male who will not get the flesh of his foreskin circumcised, even that soul must be cut off from his people. He has broken my covenant.”

412.label: Genesis 17:15
412.text: And God went on to say to Abraham: “As for Sarʹai your wife, you must not call her name Sarʹai, because Sarah is her name.

413.label: Genesis 17:16
413.text: And I will bless her and also give you a son from her; and I will bless her and she shall become nations; kings of peoples will come from her.”

414.label: Genesis 17:17
414.text: At this Abraham fell upon his face and began to laugh and to say in his heart: “Will a man a hundred years old have a child born, and will Sarah, yes, will a woman ninety years old give birth?”

415.label: Genesis 17:18
415.text: After that Abraham said to the [true] God: “O that Ishʹma·el might live before you!”

416.label: Genesis 17:19
416.text: To this God said: “Sarah your wife is indeed bearing you a son, and you must call his name Isaac. And I will establish my covenant with him for a covenant to time indefinite to his seed after him.

417.label: Genesis 17:20
417.text: But as regards Ishʹma·el I have heard you. Look! I will bless him and will make him fruitful and will multiply him very, very much. He will certainly produce twelve chieftains, and I will make him become a great nation.

418.label: Genesis 17:21
418.text: However, my covenant I shall establish with Isaac, whom Sarah will bear to you at this appointed time next year.”

419.label: Genesis 17:22
419.text: With that God finished speaking with him and went up from Abraham.

420.label: Genesis 17:23
420.text: Abraham then proceeded to take Ishʹma·el his son and all the men born in his house and everyone purchased with money of his, every male among the men of the household of Abraham, and he went to circumcising the flesh of their foreskins in this very day, just as God had spoken with him.

421.label: Genesis 17:24
421.text: And Abraham was ninety-nine years old when he had the flesh of his foreskin circumcised.

422.label: Genesis 17:25
422.text: And Ishʹma·el his son was thirteen years old when he had the flesh of his foreskin circumcised.

423.label: Genesis 17:26
423.text: In this very day Abraham got circumcised, and also Ishʹma·el his son.

424.label: Genesis 17:27
424.text: And all the men of his household, anyone born in the house and anyone purchased with money from a foreigner, got circumcised with him.

425.label: Genesis 18:1
425.text: Afterward Jehovah appeared to him among the big trees of Mamʹre, while he was sitting at the entrance of the tent about the heat of the day.

426.label: Genesis 18:2
426.text: When he raised his eyes, then he looked and there three men were standing some distance from him. When he caught sight of them he began running to meet them from the entrance of the tent and proceeded to bow down to the earth.

427.label: Genesis 18:3
427.text: Then he said: “Jehovah, if, now, I have found favor in your eyes, please do not pass by your servant.

428.label: Genesis 18:4
428.text: Let a little water be taken, please, and YOU must have YOUR feet washed. Then recline under the tree.

429.label: Genesis 18:5
429.text: And let me get a piece of bread, and refresh YOUR hearts. Following that, YOU can pass on, because that is why YOU have passed this way to YOUR servant.” At this they said: “All right. You may do just as you have spoken.”

430.label: Genesis 18:6
430.text: So Abraham went hurrying to the tent to Sarah and said: “Hurry! Get three seah measures of fine flour, knead the dough and make round cakes.”

431.label: Genesis 18:7
431.text: Next Abraham ran to the herd and proceeded to get a tender and good young bull and to give it to the attendant, and he went hurrying to get it ready.

432.label: Genesis 18:8
432.text: He then took butter and milk and the young bull that he had got ready and set it before them. Then he himself kept standing by them under the tree as they were eating.

433.label: Genesis 18:9
433.text: They now said to him: “Where is Sarah your wife?” To this he said: “Here in the tent!”

434.label: Genesis 18:10
434.text: So he continued: “I am surely going to return to you next year at this time, and, look! Sarah your wife will have a son.” Now Sarah was listening at the tent entrance, and it was behind the man.

435.label: Genesis 18:11
435.text: And Abraham and Sarah were old, being advanced in years. Sarah had stopped having menstruation.

436.label: Genesis 18:12
436.text: Hence Sarah began to laugh inside herself, saying: “After I am worn out, shall I really have pleasure, my lord being old besides?”

437.label: Genesis 18:13
437.text: Then Jehovah said to Abraham: “Why was it that Sarah laughed, saying, ‘Shall I really and truly give birth although I have become old?’

438.label: Genesis 18:14
438.text: Is anything too extraordinary for Jehovah? At the appointed time I shall return to you, next year at this time, and Sarah will have a son.”

439.label: Genesis 18:15
439.text: But Sarah began to deny it, saying: “I did not laugh!” For she was afraid. At this he said: “No! but you did laugh.”

440.label: Genesis 18:16
440.text: Later the men got up from there and looked down toward Sodʹom, and Abraham was walking with them to escort them.

441.label: Genesis 18:17
441.text: And Jehovah said: “Am I keeping covered from Abraham what I am doing?

442.label: Genesis 18:18
442.text: Why, Abraham is surely going to become a nation great and mighty, and all the nations of the earth must bless themselves by means of him.

443.label: Genesis 18:19
443.text: For I have become acquainted with him in order that he may command his sons and his household after him so that they shall keep Jehovah’s way to do righteousness and judgment; in order that Jehovah may certainly bring upon Abraham what he has spoken about him.”

444.label: Genesis 18:20
444.text: Consequently Jehovah said: “The cry of complaint about Sodʹom and Go·morʹrah, yes, it is loud, and their sin, yes, it is very heavy.

445.label: Genesis 18:21
445.text: I am quite determined to go down that I may see whether they act altogether according to the outcry over it that has come to me, and, if not, I can get to know it.”

446.label: Genesis 18:22
446.text: At this point the men turned from there and got on their way to Sodʹom; but as for Jehovah, he was still standing before Abraham.

447.label: Genesis 18:23
447.text: Then Abraham approached and began to say: “Will you really sweep away the righteous with the wicked?

448.label: Genesis 18:24
448.text: Suppose there are fifty righteous men in the midst of the city. Will you, then, sweep them away and not pardon the place for the sake of the fifty righteous who are inside it?

449.label: Genesis 18:25
449.text: It is unthinkable of you that you are acting in this manner to put to death the righteous man with the wicked one so that it has to occur with the righteous man as it does with the wicked! It is unthinkable of you. Is the Judge of all the earth not going to do what is right?”

450.label: Genesis 18:26
450.text: Then Jehovah said: “If I shall find in Sodʹom fifty righteous men in the midst of the city I will pardon the whole place on their account.”

451.label: Genesis 18:27
451.text: But Abraham went on to answer and say: “Please, here I have taken upon myself to speak to Jehovah, whereas I am dust and ashes.

452.label: Genesis 18:28
452.text: Suppose the fifty righteous should be lacking five. Will you for the five bring the whole city to ruin?” To this he said: “I shall not bring it to ruin if I find there forty-five.”

453.label: Genesis 18:29
453.text: But yet again he spoke further to him and said: “Suppose forty are found there.” In turn he said: “I shall not do it on account of the forty.”

454.label: Genesis 18:30
454.text: But he continued: “May Jehovah, please, not grow hot with anger, but let me go on speaking: Suppose thirty are found there.” In turn he said: “I shall not do it if I find thirty there.”

455.label: Genesis 18:31
455.text: But he continued on: “Please, here I have taken upon myself to speak to Jehovah: Suppose twenty are found there.” In turn he said: “I shall not bring it to ruin on account of the twenty.”

456.label: Genesis 18:32
456.text: Finally he said: “May Jehovah, please, not grow hot with anger, but let me speak just this once: Suppose ten are found there.” In turn he said: “I shall not bring it to ruin on account of the ten.”

457.label: Genesis 18:33
457.text: Then Jehovah went his way when he had finished speaking to Abraham, and Abraham returned to his place.

458.label: Genesis 19:1
458.text: Now the two angels arrived at Sodʹom by evening, and Lot was sitting in the gate of Sodʹom. When Lot caught sight of them, then he got up to meet them and bowed down with his face to the earth.

459.label: Genesis 19:2
459.text: And he proceeded to say: “Please, now, my lords, turn aside, please, into the house of YOUR servant and stay overnight and have YOUR feet washed. Then YOU must get up early and travel on YOUR way.” To this they said: “No, but in the public square is where we shall stay overnight.”

460.label: Genesis 19:3
460.text: But he was very insistent with them, so that they turned aside to him and came into his house. Then he made a feast for them, and he baked unfermented cakes, and they went to eating.

461.label: Genesis 19:4
461.text: Before they could lie down, the men of the city, the men of Sodʹom, surrounded the house, from boy to old man, all the people in one mob.

462.label: Genesis 19:5
