1331.text: But they said to him: “Why does my lord speak with such words as these? It is unthinkable that your servants should do anything like this.

1332.label: Genesis 44:8
1332.text: Why, the money that we found in the mouth of our bags we brought back to you from the land of Caʹnaan. How, then, could we steal silver or gold from the house of your master?

1333.label: Genesis 44:9
1333.text: Let the one of your slaves with whom it may be found die and let us ourselves also become slaves to my master.”

1334.label: Genesis 44:10
1334.text: So he said: “Let it be now exactly according to YOUR words. Thus the one with whom it may be found will become a slave to me, but YOU yourselves will be proved innocent.”

1335.label: Genesis 44:11
1335.text: With that they quickly let down each one his bag to the earth and they opened each one his own bag.

1336.label: Genesis 44:12
1336.text: And he went searching carefully. He started with the oldest and finished with the youngest. At last the cup was found in Benjamin’s bag.

1337.label: Genesis 44:13
1337.text: Then they ripped their mantles apart and lifted each one his load back onto his ass and returned to the city.

1338.label: Genesis 44:14
1338.text: And Judah and his brothers went on into Joseph’s house, and he was still there; and they proceeded to fall before him to the earth.

1339.label: Genesis 44:15
1339.text: Joseph now said to them: “What sort of deed is this that YOU have done? Did YOU not know that such a man as I am can expertly read omens?”

1340.label: Genesis 44:16
1340.text: At this Judah exclaimed: “What can we say to my master? What can we speak? And how can we prove ourselves righteous? The [true] God has found out the error of your slaves. Here we are slaves to my master, both we and the one in whose hand the cup was found!”

1341.label: Genesis 44:17
1341.text: However, he said: “It is unthinkable for me to do this! The man in whose hand the cup was found is the one who will become a slave to me. As for the rest of YOU, go up in peace to YOUR father.”

1342.label: Genesis 44:18
1342.text: Judah now came near to him and said: “I pray you, my master, please let your slave speak a word in the hearing of my master, and do not let your anger grow hot against your slave, because it is the same with you as with Pharʹaoh.

1343.label: Genesis 44:19
1343.text: My master asked his slaves, saying, ‘Do YOU have a father or a brother?’

1344.label: Genesis 44:20
1344.text: So we said to my master, ‘We do have an aged father and a child of his old age, the youngest. But his brother is dead so that he alone is left of his mother, and his father does love him.’

1345.label: Genesis 44:21
1345.text: After that you said to your slaves, ‘Bring him down to me that I may set my eye upon him.’

1346.label: Genesis 44:22
1346.text: But we said to my master, ‘The boy is not able to leave his father. If he did leave his father, he would certainly die.’

1347.label: Genesis 44:23
1347.text: Then you said to your slaves, ‘Unless YOUR youngest brother comes down with YOU, YOU may not see my face anymore.’

1348.label: Genesis 44:24
1348.text: “And it came about that we went up to your slave my father and then told him the words of my master.

1349.label: Genesis 44:25
1349.text: Later our father said, ‘Return, buy a little food for us.’

1350.label: Genesis 44:26
1350.text: But we said, ‘We are not able to go down. If our youngest brother is with us we will go down, because we are not able to see the man’s face in case our youngest brother is not with us.’

1351.label: Genesis 44:27
1351.text: Then your slave my father said to us, ‘YOU yourselves well know that my wife bore but two sons to me.

1352.label: Genesis 44:28
1352.text: Later the one went out from my company and I exclaimed: “Ah, he must surely be torn to pieces!” and I have not seen him till now.

1353.label: Genesis 44:29
1353.text: If YOU were to take this one also out of my sight and a fatal accident were to befall him, YOU would certainly bring down my gray hairs with calamity to Sheʹol.’

1354.label: Genesis 44:30
1354.text: “And now, as soon as I should come to your slave my father without the boy along with us, when that one’s soul is bound up with this one’s soul,

1355.label: Genesis 44:31
1355.text: then it is certain to occur that as soon as he sees that the boy is not there he will simply die, and your slaves will indeed bring down the gray hairs of your slave our father with grief to Sheʹol.

1356.label: Genesis 44:32
1356.text: For your slave became surety for the boy when away from his father, saying, ‘If I fail to bring him back to you, then I shall have sinned against my father forever.’

1357.label: Genesis 44:33
1357.text: So now, please, let your slave stay instead of the boy as a slave to my master, that the boy may go up with his brothers.

1358.label: Genesis 44:34
1358.text: For how can I go up to my father without the boy along with me, for fear that then I may look upon the calamity that will find out my father?”

1359.label: Genesis 45:1
1359.text: At this Joseph was no longer able to control himself before all those who were stationed by him. So he cried out: “HAVE everybody go out from me!” And no one else stood with him while Joseph made himself known to his brothers.

1360.label: Genesis 45:2
1360.text: And he began to raise his voice in weeping, so that the Egyptians got to hear it and Pharʹaoh’s house got to hear it.

1361.label: Genesis 45:3
1361.text: Finally Joseph said to his brothers: “I am Joseph. Is my father still alive?” But his brothers were unable to answer him at all, because they were disturbed by reason of him.

1362.label: Genesis 45:4
1362.text: So Joseph said to his brothers: “Come close to me, please.” With that they came close to him. Then he said: “I am Joseph YOUR brother, whom YOU sold into Egypt.

1363.label: Genesis 45:5
1363.text: But now do not feel hurt and do not be angry with yourselves because YOU sold me here; because for the preservation of life God has sent me ahead of YOU.

1364.label: Genesis 45:6
1364.text: For this is the second year of the famine in the midst of the earth, and there are yet five years in which there will be no plowing time or harvest.

1365.label: Genesis 45:7
1365.text: Consequently God sent me ahead of YOU in order to place a remnant for YOU men in the earth and to keep YOU alive by a great escape.

1366.label: Genesis 45:8
1366.text: So now it was not YOU who sent me here, but it was the [true] God, that he might appoint me a father to Pharʹaoh and a lord for all his house and as one dominating over all the land of Egypt.

1367.label: Genesis 45:9
1367.text: “Go up quickly to my father, and YOU must say to him, ‘This is what your son Joseph has said: “God has appointed me lord for all Egypt. Come down to me. Do not delay.

1368.label: Genesis 45:10
1368.text: And you must dwell in the land of Goʹshen, and you must continue near me, you and your sons and the sons of your sons and your flocks and your herds and everything you have.

1369.label: Genesis 45:11
1369.text: And I will supply you with food there, for there are yet five years of famine; for fear you and your house and everything you have may come to poverty.”’

1370.label: Genesis 45:12
1370.text: And here YOUR eyes and the eyes of my brother Benjamin are seeing that it is my mouth that is speaking to YOU.

1371.label: Genesis 45:13
1371.text: So YOU must tell my father about all my glory in Egypt and everything YOU have seen; and YOU must hurry and bring my father down here.”

1372.label: Genesis 45:14
1372.text: Then he fell upon the neck of Benjamin his brother and gave way to weeping, and Benjamin wept upon his neck.

1373.label: Genesis 45:15
1373.text: And he proceeded to kiss all his brothers and to weep over them, and after that his brothers spoke with him.

1374.label: Genesis 45:16
1374.text: And the news was heard at the house of Pharʹaoh, saying: “Joseph’s brothers have come!” And it proved to be good in the eyes of Pharʹaoh and of his servants.

1375.label: Genesis 45:17
1375.text: Accordingly Pharʹaoh said to Joseph: “Say to your brothers, ‘Do this: Load YOUR beasts of burden and go enter the land of Caʹnaan,

1376.label: Genesis 45:18
1376.text: and take YOUR father and YOUR households and come here to me, that I may give YOU the good of the land of Egypt; and eat the fat part of the land.

1377.label: Genesis 45:19
1377.text: And you yourself are commanded: “Do this: TAKE for yourselves wagons from the land of Egypt for YOUR little ones and YOUR wives, and YOU must lift YOUR father on one and come here.

1378.label: Genesis 45:20
1378.text: And do not let YOUR eye feel sorry over YOUR equipment, because the good of all the land of Egypt is YOURS.”’”

1379.label: Genesis 45:21
1379.text: Following that the sons of Israel did so, and Joseph gave them wagons according to Pharʹaoh’s orders and gave them provisions for the way.

1380.label: Genesis 45:22
1380.text: To each of them he gave individual changes of mantles, but to Benjamin he gave three hundred silver pieces and five changes of mantles.

1381.label: Genesis 45:23
1381.text: And to his father he sent as follows: ten asses carrying good things of Egypt and ten she-asses carrying grain and bread and sustenance for his father for the way.

1382.label: Genesis 45:24
1382.text: Thus he sent his brothers off, and they proceeded to go. However, he said to them: “Do not get exasperated at one another on the way.”

1383.label: Genesis 45:25
1383.text: And they began going up out of Egypt and at length came into the land of Caʹnaan to Jacob their father.

1384.label: Genesis 45:26
1384.text: Then they reported to him, saying: “Joseph is still alive, and he is the one dominating over all the land of Egypt!” But his heart grew numb, because he did not believe them.

1385.label: Genesis 45:27
1385.text: When they went on speaking to him all of Joseph’s words that he had spoken to them and he got to see the wagons that Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of Jacob their father began to revive.

1386.label: Genesis 45:28
1386.text: Then Israel exclaimed: “It is enough! Joseph my son is still alive! Ah, let me go and see him before I die!”

1387.label: Genesis 46:1
1387.text: Accordingly Israel and all who were his pulled out and came to Beʹer-sheʹba, and he proceeded to sacrifice sacrifices to the God of his father Isaac.

1388.label: Genesis 46:2
1388.text: Then God talked to Israel in visions of the night and said: “Jacob, Jacob!” to which he said: “Here I am!”

1389.label: Genesis 46:3
1389.text: And he went on to say: “I am the [true] God, the God of your father. Do not be afraid to go down to Egypt, for I shall constitute you there into a great nation.

1390.label: Genesis 46:4
1390.text: I myself shall go down with you to Egypt and I myself shall surely bring you up also; and Joseph will lay his hand upon your eyes.”

1391.label: Genesis 46:5
1391.text: After that Jacob got up out of Beʹer-sheʹba, and the sons of Israel continued transporting Jacob their father and their little ones and their wives in the wagons that Pharʹaoh had sent to transport him.

1392.label: Genesis 46:6
1392.text: Further, they took along their herds and their goods, which they had accumulated in the land of Caʹnaan. Eventually they came into Egypt, Jacob and all his offspring with him.

1393.label: Genesis 46:7
1393.text: He brought his sons and his sons’ sons with him, his daughters and his sons’ daughters, even all his offspring, with him into Egypt.

1394.label: Genesis 46:8
1394.text: Now these are the names of Israel’s sons who came into Egypt: Jacob and his sons: Jacob’s firstborn was Reuʹben.

1395.label: Genesis 46:9
1395.text: And the sons of Reuʹben were Haʹnoch and Palʹlu and Hezʹron and Carʹmi.

1396.label: Genesis 46:10
1396.text: And the sons of Simʹe·on were Jem·uʹel and Jaʹmin and Oʹhad and Jaʹchin and Zoʹhar and Shaʹul the son of a Caʹnaan·ite woman.

1397.label: Genesis 46:11
1397.text: And the sons of Leʹvi were Gerʹshon, Koʹhath and Me·rarʹi.

1398.label: Genesis 46:12
1398.text: And the sons of Judah were Er and Oʹnan and Sheʹlah and Peʹrez and Zeʹrah. However, Er and Oʹnan died in the land of Caʹnaan. And the sons of Peʹrez came to be Hezʹron and Haʹmul.

1399.label: Genesis 46:13
1399.text: And the sons of Isʹsa·char were Toʹla and Puʹvah and Iob and Shimʹron.

1400.label: Genesis 46:14
1400.text: And the sons of Zebʹu·lun were Seʹred and Eʹlon and Jahʹle·el.

1401.label: Genesis 46:15
1401.text: These are the sons of Leʹah, whom she bore to Jacob in Padʹdan-aʹram, together with his daughter Diʹnah. All the souls of his sons and of his daughters were thirty-three.

1402.label: Genesis 46:16
1402.text: And the sons of Gad were Ziphʹi·on and Hagʹgi, Shuʹni and Ezʹbon, Eʹri and Ar·oʹdi and A·reʹli.

1403.label: Genesis 46:17
1403.text: And the sons of Ashʹer were Imʹnah and Ishʹvah and Ishʹvi and Be·riʹah, and there was Seʹrah their sister. And the sons of Be·riʹah were Heʹber and Malʹchi·el.

1404.label: Genesis 46:18
1404.text: These are the sons of Zilʹpah, whom Laʹban gave to his daughter Leʹah. In time she bore these to Jacob: sixteen souls.

1405.label: Genesis 46:19
1405.text: The sons of Rachel, Jacob’s wife, were Joseph and Benjamin.

1406.label: Genesis 46:20
1406.text: And there came to be born to Joseph in the land of Egypt Ma·nasʹseh and Eʹphra·im, whom Asʹe·nath the daughter of Pot·iʹphe·ra the priest of On bore to him.

1407.label: Genesis 46:21
1407.text: And the sons of Benjamin were Beʹla and Beʹcher and Ashʹbel, Geʹra and Naʹa·man, Eʹhi and Rosh, Mupʹpim and Hupʹpim and Ard.

1408.label: Genesis 46:22
1408.text: These are the sons of Rachel who were born to Jacob. All the souls were fourteen.

1409.label: Genesis 46:23
1409.text: And the sons of Dan were Huʹshim.

1410.label: Genesis 46:24
1410.text: And the sons of Naphʹta·li were Jahʹze·el and Guʹni and Jeʹzer and Shilʹlem.

1411.label: Genesis 46:25
1411.text: These are the sons of Bilʹhah, whom Laʹban gave to his daughter Rachel. In time she bore these to Jacob; all the souls were seven.

1412.label: Genesis 46:26
1412.text: All the souls who came to Jacob into Egypt were those who issued out of his upper thigh, aside from the wives of Jacob’s sons. All the souls were sixty-six.

1413.label: Genesis 46:27
1413.text: And Joseph’s sons who were born to him in Egypt were two souls. All the souls of the house of Jacob who came into Egypt were seventy.

1414.label: Genesis 46:28
1414.text: And he sent Judah in advance of him to Joseph to impart information ahead of him to Goʹshen. After that they came into the land of Goʹshen.

1415.label: Genesis 46:29
1415.text: Then Joseph had his chariot made ready and went up to meet Israel his father at Goʹshen. When he appeared to him he at once fell upon his neck and gave way to tears upon his neck again and again.

1416.label: Genesis 46:30
1416.text: Finally Israel said to Joseph: “This time I am willing to die, now that I have seen your face, since you are still alive.”

1417.label: Genesis 46:31
1417.text: Then Joseph said to his brothers and to his father’s household: “Let me go up and report to Pharʹaoh and say to him, ‘My brothers and my father’s household who were in the land of Caʹnaan have come here to me.

1418.label: Genesis 46:32
1418.text: And the men are shepherds, because they became stock raisers; and their flocks and their herds and all they have they have brought here.’

1419.label: Genesis 46:33
1419.text: And what must occur is that when Pharʹaoh will call YOU and actually say, ‘What is YOUR occupation?’

1420.label: Genesis 46:34
1420.text: YOU must say, ‘Your servants have continued to be stock raisers from our youth until now, both we and our forefathers,’ in order that YOU may dwell in the land of Goʹshen, because every herder of sheep is a detestable thing to Egypt.”

1421.label: Genesis 47:1
1421.text: Accordingly Joseph came and reported to Pharʹaoh and said: “My father and my brothers and their flocks and their herds and all they have have come from the land of Caʹnaan, and here they are in the land of Goʹshen.”

1422.label: Genesis 47:2
1422.text: And from the whole number of his brothers he took five men, that he might present them to Pharʹaoh.

1423.label: Genesis 47:3
1423.text: Then Pharʹaoh said to his brothers: “What is YOUR occupation?” So they said to Pharʹaoh: “Your servants are herders of sheep, both we and our forefathers.”

1424.label: Genesis 47:4
1424.text: After that they said to Pharʹaoh: “We have come to reside as aliens in the land, because there is no pasturage for the flock that your servants have, for the famine is severe in the land of Caʹnaan. And now let your servants dwell, please, in the land of Goʹshen.”

1425.label: Genesis 47:5
1425.text: At that Pharʹaoh said to Joseph: “Your father and your brothers have come here to you.

1426.label: Genesis 47:6
1426.text: The land of Egypt is at your disposal. Have your father and your brothers dwell in the very best of the land. Let them dwell in the land of Goʹshen, and if you know that there are among them courageous men, you must appoint them cattle chiefs over what is mine.”

1427.label: Genesis 47:7
1427.text: Then Joseph brought in Jacob his father and introduced him to Pharʹaoh, and Jacob proceeded to bless Pharʹaoh.

1428.label: Genesis 47:8
1428.text: Pharʹaoh now said to Jacob: “How many are the days of the years of your life?”

1429.label: Genesis 47:9
1429.text: So Jacob said to Pharʹaoh: “The days of the years of my alien residences are a hundred and thirty years. Few and distressing the days of the years of my life have proved, and they have not reached the days of the years of the lives of my fathers in the days of their alien residences.”

1430.label: Genesis 47:10
1430.text: After that Jacob blessed Pharʹaoh and went out from before Pharʹaoh.

1431.label: Genesis 47:11
1431.text: Thus Joseph had his father and his brothers dwell and he gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the very best of the land, in the land of Ramʹe·ses, just as Pharʹaoh had commanded.

1432.label: Genesis 47:12
1432.text: And Joseph kept supplying his father and his brothers and the entire household of his father with bread, according to the number of the little ones.

1433.label: Genesis 47:13
1433.text: Now there was no bread in all the land, because the famine was very severe; and the land of Egypt and the land of Caʹnaan became exhausted as a result of the famine.

1434.label: Genesis 47:14
1434.text: And Joseph went on picking up all the money that was to be found in the land of Egypt and in the land of Caʹnaan for the cereals which people were buying; and Joseph kept bringing the money into Pharʹaoh’s house.

1435.label: Genesis 47:15
1435.text: In time the money from the land of Egypt and the land of Caʹnaan was spent, and all the Egyptians began coming to Joseph, saying: “Give us bread! And why should we die in front of you because money has run out?”

1436.label: Genesis 47:16
1436.text: Then Joseph said: “Hand over YOUR livestock and I shall give YOU bread in exchange for YOUR livestock, if money has run out.”

1437.label: Genesis 47:17
1437.text: And they began bringing their livestock to Joseph; and Joseph kept giving them bread in exchange for their horses and the livestock of the flock and the livestock of the herd and the asses, and he kept providing them with bread in exchange for all their livestock during that year.

1438.label: Genesis 47:18
1438.text: Gradually that year came to its close, and they began coming to him in the next year and saying to him: “We shall not hide it from my lord but the money and the stock of domestic animals have been spent to my lord. There remains nothing before my lord but our bodies and our land.

1439.label: Genesis 47:19
1439.text: Why should we die before your eyes, both we and our land? Buy us and our land for bread, and we together with our land will become slaves to Pharʹaoh; and give us seed that we may live and not die and our land not be laid desolate.”

1440.label: Genesis 47:20
1440.text: So Joseph bought all the land of the Egyptians for Pharʹaoh, because the Egyptians sold each one his field, for the famine had got a strong grip on them; and the land came to be Pharʹaoh’s.

1441.label: Genesis 47:21
1441.text: As for the people, he removed them into cities from one end of the territory of Egypt to its other end.

1442.label: Genesis 47:22
1442.text: Only the land of the priests he did not buy, because the rations for the priests were from Pharʹaoh and they ate their rations that Pharʹaoh gave them. That is why they did not sell their land.

1443.label: Genesis 47:23
1443.text: Then Joseph said to the people: “See, I have today bought YOU and YOUR land for Pharʹaoh. Here is seed for YOU, and YOU must sow the land with it.

1444.label: Genesis 47:24
1444.text: When it has resulted in produce, then YOU must give a fifth to Pharʹaoh, but four parts will become YOURS as seed for the field and as food for YOU and for those who are in YOUR houses and for YOUR little ones to eat.”

1445.label: Genesis 47:25
1445.text: Consequently they said: “You have preserved our lives. Let us find favor in the eyes of my lord, and we will become slaves to Pharʹaoh.”

1446.label: Genesis 47:26
1446.text: And Joseph proceeded to make it a decree down to this day over the landed estate of Egypt for Pharʹaoh to have to the amount of a fifth. Only the land of the priests as a distinct group did not become Pharʹaoh’s.

1447.label: Genesis 47:27
1447.text: And Israel continued to dwell in the land of Egypt, in the land of Goʹshen; and they became settled in it and were fruitful and grew to be very many.

1448.label: Genesis 47:28
1448.text: And Jacob lived on in the land of Egypt for seventeen years, so that Jacob’s days, the years of his life, came to be a hundred and forty-seven years.

1449.label: Genesis 47:29
1449.text: Gradually the days approached for Israel to die. So he called his son Joseph and said to him: “If, now, I have found favor in your eyes, place your hand, please, under my thigh, and you must exercise loving-kindness and trustworthiness toward me. (Please, do not bury me in Egypt.)

1450.label: Genesis 47:30
1450.text: And I must lie with my fathers, and you must carry me out of Egypt and bury me in their grave.” Accordingly he said: “I myself shall do in keeping with your word.”

1451.label: Genesis 47:31
1451.text: Then he said: “Swear to me.” So he swore to him. At that Israel prostrated himself over the head of the couch.

1452.label: Genesis 48:1
1452.text: And it came about after these things that it was said to Joseph: “Look, your father is becoming weak.” At that he took with him his two sons Ma·nasʹseh and Eʹphra·im.

1453.label: Genesis 48:2
1453.text: Then it was reported to Jacob and said: “Here your son Joseph has come to you.” So Israel exerted his strength and sat up on his couch.

1454.label: Genesis 48:3
1454.text: And Jacob proceeded to say to Joseph: “God Almighty appeared to me at Luz in the land of Caʹnaan that he might bless me.

1455.label: Genesis 48:4
1455.text: And he went on to say to me, ‘Here I am making you fruitful, and I will make you many and I will transform you into a congregation of peoples and I will give this land to your seed after you for a possession to time indefinite.’

1456.label: Genesis 48:5
1456.text: And now your two sons who were born to you in the land of Egypt before I came here to you into Egypt, they are mine. Eʹphra·im and Ma·nasʹseh will become mine like Reuʹben and Simʹe·on.

1457.label: Genesis 48:6
1457.text: But your progeny to which you shall become father after them will become yours. Together with the name of their brothers they will be called in their inheritance.

1458.label: Genesis 48:7
1458.text: And as for me, when I was coming from Padʹdan, Rachel died alongside me in the land of Caʹnaan on the way while there was yet a good stretch of land before coming to Ephʹrath, so that I buried her there on the way to Ephʹrath, that is to say, Bethʹle·hem.”

1459.label: Genesis 48:8
1459.text: Then Israel saw Joseph’s sons and said: “Who are these?”

1460.label: Genesis 48:9
1460.text: So Joseph said to his father: “They are my sons whom God has given me in this place.” At this he said: “Bring them, please, to me that I may bless them.”

1461.label: Genesis 48:10
1461.text: Now the eyes of Israel were dull from old age. He was unable to see. Accordingly he brought them close to him, and he then kissed them and embraced them.

1462.label: Genesis 48:11
1462.text: And Israel went on to say to Joseph: “I had no idea of seeing your face, but here God has let me see also your offspring.”

1463.label: Genesis 48:12
1463.text: After that Joseph brought them out away from his knees, and he bowed down with his face to the earth.

1464.label: Genesis 48:13
1464.text: Joseph now took the two of them, Eʹphra·im by his right hand to Israel’s left, and Ma·nasʹseh by his left hand to Israel’s right, and brought them close to him.

1465.label: Genesis 48:14
1465.text: However, Israel put out his right hand and placed it on Eʹphra·im’s head, although he was the younger, and his left hand upon Ma·nasʹseh’s head. He purposely laid his hands so, since Ma·nasʹseh was the firstborn.

1466.label: Genesis 48:15
1466.text: And he proceeded to bless Joseph and to say: “The [true] God before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac walked, The [true] God who has been shepherding me during all my existence until this day,

1467.label: Genesis 48:16
1467.text: The angel who has been recovering me from all calamity, bless the boys. And let my name be called upon them and the name of my fathers, Abraham and Isaac, And let them increase to a multitude in the midst of the earth.”

1468.label: Genesis 48:17
1468.text: When Joseph saw that his father kept his right hand placed on Eʹphra·im’s head, it was displeasing to him, and he tried to take hold of his father’s hand to remove it from Eʹphra·im’s head to Ma·nasʹseh’s head.

1469.label: Genesis 48:18
1469.text: Hence Joseph said to his father: “Not so, my father, because this is the firstborn. Put your right hand on his head.”

1470.label: Genesis 48:19
1470.text: But his father kept refusing and said: “I know it, my son, I know it. He too will become a people and he too will become great. But, just the same, his younger brother will become greater than he will, and his offspring will become the full equivalent of nations.”

1471.label: Genesis 48:20
1471.text: And he continued to bless them on that day, saying: “By means of you let Israel repeatedly pronounce blessing, saying,‘May God constitute you like Eʹphra·im and like Ma·nasʹseh.’” Thus he kept putting Eʹphra·im before Ma·nasʹseh.

1472.label: Genesis 48:21
1472.text: After that Israel said to Joseph: “Look, I am dying, but God will certainly continue with YOU people and return YOU to the land of YOUR forefathers.

1473.label: Genesis 48:22
1473.text: As for me, I do give you one shoulder [of land] more than to your brothers, which I took from the hand of the Amʹor·ites by my sword and by my bow.”

1474.label: Genesis 49:1
1474.text: Later on Jacob called his sons and said: “Gather yourselves together that I may tell YOU what will happen to YOU in the final part of the days.

1475.label: Genesis 49:2
1475.text: Assemble yourselves and listen, YOU sons of Jacob, yes, listen to Israel YOUR father.

1476.label: Genesis 49:3
1476.text: “Reuʹben, you are my firstborn, my vigor and the beginning of my generative power, the excellence of dignity and the excellence of strength.

1477.label: Genesis 49:4
1477.text: With reckless license like waters, do not you excel, because you have gone up to your father’s bed. At that time you profaned my lounge. He went up to it!

1478.label: Genesis 49:5
1478.text: “Simʹe·on and Leʹvi are brothers. Instruments of violence are their slaughter weapons.

1479.label: Genesis 49:6
1479.text: Into their intimate group do not come, O my soul. With their congregation do not become united, O my disposition, because in their anger they killed men, and in their arbitrariness they hamstrung bulls.

1480.label: Genesis 49:7
1480.text: Cursed be their anger, because it is cruel, and their fury, because it acts harshly. Let me parcel them out in Jacob and let me scatter them in Israel.

1481.label: Genesis 49:8
1481.text: “As for you, Judah, your brothers will laud you. Your hand will be on the back of the neck of your enemies. The sons of your father will prostrate themselves to you.

1482.label: Genesis 49:9
1482.text: A lion cub Judah is. From the prey, my son, you will certainly go up. He bowed down, he stretched himself out like a lion and, like a lion, who dares rouse him?

1483.label: Genesis 49:10
1483.text: The scepter will not turn aside from Judah, neither the commander’s staff from between his feet, until Shiʹloh comes; and to him the obedience of the peoples will belong.

1484.label: Genesis 49:11
1484.text: Tying his full-grown ass to a vine and the descendant of his own she-ass to a choice vine, he will certainly wash his clothing in wine and his garment in the blood of grapes.

1485.label: Genesis 49:12
1485.text: Dark red are his eyes from wine, and the whiteness of his teeth is from milk.

1486.label: Genesis 49:13
1486.text: “Zebʹu·lun will reside by the seashore, and he will be by the shore where the ships lie anchored; and his remote side will be toward Siʹdon.

1487.label: Genesis 49:14
1487.text: “Isʹsa·char is a strong-boned ass, lying down between the two saddlebags.

1488.label: Genesis 49:15
1488.text: And he will see that the resting-place is good and that the land is pleasant; and he will bend down his shoulder to bear burdens and he will become subject to slavish forced labor.

1489.label: Genesis 49:16
1489.text: “Dan will judge his people as one of the tribes of Israel.

1490.label: Genesis 49:17
1490.text: Let Dan prove to be a serpent by the roadside, a horned snake at the wayside, that bites the heels of the horse so that its rider falls backward.

1491.label: Genesis 49:18
1491.text: I shall indeed wait for salvation from you, O Jehovah.

1492.label: Genesis 49:19
1492.text: “As for Gad, a marauder band will raid him, but he will raid the extreme rear.

1493.label: Genesis 49:20
1493.text: “Out of Ashʹer his bread will be fat, and he will give the dainties of a king.

1494.label: Genesis 49:21
1494.text: “Naphʹta·li is a slender hind. He is giving words of elegance.

1495.label: Genesis 49:22
1495.text: “Offshoot of a fruit-bearing tree, Joseph is the offshoot of a fruit-bearing tree by the fountain, that propels its branches up over a wall.

1496.label: Genesis 49:23
1496.text: But the archers kept harassing him and shot at him and kept harboring animosity against him.

1497.label: Genesis 49:24
1497.text: And yet his bow was dwelling in a permanent place, and the strength of his hands was supple. From the hands of the powerful one of Jacob, from there is the shepherd, the stone of Israel.

1498.label: Genesis 49:25
1498.text: He is from the God of your father, and he will help you; and he is with the Almighty, and he will bless you with the blessings of the heavens above, with the blessings of the watery deep lying down below, with the blessings of the breasts and womb.

1499.label: Genesis 49:26
1499.text: The blessings of your father will indeed be superior to the blessings of the eternal mountains, to the ornament of the indefinitely lasting hills. They will continue upon the head of Joseph, even upon the crown of the head of the one singled out from his brothers.

1500.label: Genesis 49:27
1500.text: “Benjamin will keep on tearing like a wolf. In the morning he will eat the animal seized and at evening he will divide spoil.”

1501.label: Genesis 49:28
1501.text: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel, and this is what their father spoke to them when he was blessing them. He blessed them each one according to his own blessing.

1502.label: Genesis 49:29
1502.text: After that he commanded them and said to them: “I am being gathered to my people. Bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Eʹphron the Hitʹtite,

1503.label: Genesis 49:30
1503.text: in the cave that is in the field of Mach·peʹlah that is in front of Mamʹre in the land of Caʹnaan, the field that Abraham purchased from Eʹphron the Hitʹtite for the possession of a burial place.

1504.label: Genesis 49:31
1504.text: There they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife. There they buried Isaac and Re·bekʹah his wife, and there I buried Leʹah.

1505.label: Genesis 49:32
1505.text: The field purchased and the cave that is in it were from the sons of Heth.”

1506.label: Genesis 49:33
1506.text: Thus Jacob finished giving commands to his sons. Then he gathered his feet up onto the couch and expired and was gathered to his people.

1507.label: Genesis 50:1
1507.text: Then Joseph fell upon the face of his father and burst into tears over him and kissed him.

1508.label: Genesis 50:2
1508.text: After that Joseph commanded his servants, the physicians, to embalm his father. So the physicians embalmed Israel,

1509.label: Genesis 50:3
1509.text: and they took fully forty days for him, for this many days they customarily take for the embalming, and the Egyptians continued to shed tears for him seventy days.

1510.label: Genesis 50:4
1510.text: Finally the days of weeping for him passed, and Joseph spoke to Pharʹaoh’s household, saying: “If, now, I have found favor in YOUR eyes, speak, please, in the hearing of Pharʹaoh, saying,

1511.label: Genesis 50:5
1511.text: ‘My father made me swear, saying: “Look! I am dying. In my burial place which I have excavated for myself in the land of Caʹnaan is where you are to bury me.” And now, please, let me go up and bury my father, after which I am willing to return.’”

1512.label: Genesis 50:6
1512.text: Accordingly Pharʹaoh said: “Go up and bury your father just as he made you swear.”

1513.label: Genesis 50:7
1513.text: So Joseph went up to bury his father, and there went up with him all of Pharʹaoh’s servants, the older men of his household and all the older men of the land of Egypt,

1514.label: Genesis 50:8
1514.text: and all of Joseph’s household and his brothers and the household of his father. Only their little children and their flocks and their herds they left in the land of Goʹshen.

1515.label: Genesis 50:9
1515.text: There also went up with him both chariots and horsemen, and the camp came to be very numerous.

1516.label: Genesis 50:10
1516.text: Then they came to the threshing floor of Aʹtad, which is in the region of the Jordan, and there they carried on a very great and heavy wailing and he kept up the mourning rites for his father seven days.

1517.label: Genesis 50:11
1517.text: And the inhabitants of the land, the Caʹnaan·ites, got to see the mourning rites in the threshing floor of Aʹtad, and they exclaimed: “This is a heavy mourning for the Egyptians!” That is why its name was called Aʹbel-mizʹra·im, which is in the region of the Jordan.

1518.label: Genesis 50:12
1518.text: And his sons proceeded to do for him exactly as he had commanded them.

1519.label: Genesis 50:13
1519.text: So his sons carried him into the land of Caʹnaan and buried him in the cave of the field of Mach·peʹlah, the field that Abraham had purchased for the possession of a burial place from Eʹphron the Hitʹtite in front of Mamʹre.

1520.label: Genesis 50:14
1520.text: Afterward Joseph returned to Egypt, he and his brothers and all those who went up with him to bury his father, after he had buried his father.

1521.label: Genesis 50:15
1521.text: When the brothers of Joseph saw that their father was dead, they began to say: “It may be that Joseph is harboring animosity against us and he will be sure to repay us for all the evil that we have rendered him.”

1522.label: Genesis 50:16
1522.text: So they expressed a command to Joseph in these words: “Your father gave the command before his death, saying,

1523.label: Genesis 50:17
1523.text: ‘This is what YOU are to say to Joseph: “I beseech you, pardon, please, the revolt of your brothers and their sin in that they have rendered evil to you.”’ And now pardon, please, the revolt of the servants of your father’s God.” And Joseph burst into tears when they spoke to him.

1524.label: Genesis 50:18
1524.text: Following that his brothers also came and fell down before him and said: “Here we are as slaves to you!”

1525.label: Genesis 50:19
1525.text: Then Joseph said to them: “Do not be afraid, for am I in the place of God?

1526.label: Genesis 50:20
1526.text: As for YOU, YOU had evil in mind against me. God had it in mind for good for the purpose of acting as at this day to preserve many people alive.

1527.label: Genesis 50:21
1527.text: So now do not be afraid. I myself shall keep supplying YOU and YOUR little children with food.” Thus he comforted them and spoke reassuringly to them.

1528.label: Genesis 50:22
1528.text: And Joseph continued to dwell in Egypt, he and the house of his father; and Joseph lived for a hundred and ten years.

1529.label: Genesis 50:23
1529.text: And Joseph got to see Eʹphra·im’s sons of the third generation, also the sons of Maʹchir, Ma·nasʹseh’s son. They were born upon Joseph’s knees.

1530.label: Genesis 50:24
1530.text: At length Joseph said to his brothers: “I am dying; but God will without fail turn his attention to YOU, and he will certainly bring YOU up out of this land to the land about which he swore to Abraham, to Isaac and to Jacob.”

1531.label: Genesis 50:25
1531.text: Hence Joseph made the sons of Israel swear, saying: “God will without fail turn his attention to YOU. Accordingly YOU must take my bones up out of here.”

1532.label: Genesis 50:26
1532.text: After that Joseph died at the age of a hundred and ten years; and they had him embalmed, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.
